friend_in_need.notes_en: Play as  Sinkiang, right click on the  Soviet Union, click "Ask to join Faction", and click "Send" on the pop-up. It's that simple.
friend_in_need.tsv_name: Friend in Need Join a faction.

canada_first.requirements_en: In faction with  Germany    Germany is a faction leader
canada_first.requirements_ja: カナダで、枢軸国に参加する
canada_first.notes_en: On historical mode, simply go down the focus path towards Join Germany.   Note: The faction does not need be the Axis, but it must be led by  Germany.
canada_first.notes_ja: 元ネタはAmerica First。本実績実装より後の話ではあるがドナルド・トランプにより有名となった。
canada_first.tsv_name: Canada First（カナダ第一） Join Axis as Canada.

transport_tycoon.notes_en: As the  United States or  United Kingdom, set all of your Naval dockyards to convoy production and stay out of any wars.
transport_tycoon.notes_ja: 元ネタは経営シミュレーションゲーム『トランスポートタイクーン』
transport_tycoon.tsv_name: Transport Tycoon（トランスポートタイクーン） Have at least 1000 convoys.

destroyer_of_worlds.notes_en: This achievement is ideally tackled as a nation that can receive more than just the standard nuclear research bonus in the generic focus tree.  Germany is an ideal choice if one goes Democratic, given that on top of a bonus to nuclear weapons, it can get an ahead of time bonus on nukes.
destroyer_of_worlds.notes_ja: おのれディケイド・・・ではなくロバート・オッペンハイマーの「我は死神なり、世界の破壊者なり」より。さらに元はインドの聖典「バガヴァッド・ギーター」より
destroyer_of_worlds.tsv_name: Destroyer of Worlds（世界の破壊者） Deploy a nuke.

wunderwaffen.requirements_en: Has completed special project Nuclear Fission Bomb Project   Has completed special project Me 163 Komet (Rocket Interceptor)   Has completed special project Jet Engine
wunderwaffen.requirements_ja: すべての核・ジェット・ロケット技術を研究する
wunderwaffen.notes_en: Follow the strategy for Poland Can Into Space achievement and simply research additional technologies.
wunderwaffen.notes_ja: ドイツ語で奇跡(脅威)の兵器。エヴァQのAAAヴンダーでお馴染み。なおアイコンはハウニブーという架空兵器
wunderwaffen.tsv_name: Wunderwaffen（ヴンダーヴァッフェン） Has completed the Special Projects Nuclear Fission Bomb, Rocket Interceptor and Jet Engines.

united_netherlands.requirements_en: Owns and controls:   Vlaanderen (6)  Wallonie (34)  Antwerpen (977)  Ardennes (980)  Luxembourg (8)  Brabant (35)  Holland (7)  Friesland (36)
united_netherlands.requirements_ja: オランダで、ベルギー、ルクセンブルクを獲得する（占領のみではダメ、講和会議で獲得のみ）
united_netherlands.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see United Netherlands (achievement)
united_netherlands.notes_ja:
ウイーン会議後からベルギー独立までの短期間に存在した実在の国が元ネタ。
DLC無しではバージョンアップにより取得は容易ではなくなった。正当化で国際緊張度25パーセントを超えてくると英仏が独立保障をかけて邪魔してくるので、簡単ではない。
MtG有りで有れば、民主主義独自陣営ルートでNF取得していくだけで簡単に取得出来るようになっている。
united_netherlands.tsv_name: United Netherlands（低地地方統一） Conquer Belgium and Luxembourg as Netherlands.

vive_la_france.requirements_en: Has surrendered   Has capitulated   After Dec 31st, 1947
vive_la_france.requirements_ja: フランスで、他国に占領されずに1948年1月1日を迎える
vive_la_france.notes_en: Flip to fascism through an advisor or national foci, and join the Axis. Do not join any wars. Just AFK until 1948.
vive_la_france.notes_ja:
そのままフランス語で『フランス万歳』
ファシ化し枢軸国入りすれば簡単に達成できる
コルシカも対象に含まれるので要注意
vive_la_france.tsv_name: Vive la France（ヴィヴ・ラ・フランス） Reach 1948 as France without capitulating or surrendering.

master_of_war.requirements_en: Has completed doctrine track: Infantry  Has completed doctrine track: Artillery & Combat Support  Has completed doctrine track: Armor  Has completed doctrine track: Operations  Has completed doctrine track: Capital Ships  Has completed doctrine track: Carriers  Has completed doctrine track: Screens  Has completed doctrine track: Submarines  Has completed doctrine track: Fighter Aircraft  Has completed doctrine track: Strike Aircraft  Has completed doctrine track: Medium Aircraft  Has completed doctrine track: Heavy Aircraft
master_of_war.requirements_ja: 陸・海・空軍ドクトリンツリーを全て研究する
master_of_war.notes_ja: 元ネタはボブ・ディランの曲「Masters of War」
master_of_war.tsv_name: Master of War（マスター・オブ・ウォー） Fully research a land, air and naval doctrine tree.

true_blitzkrieg.requirements_en: Before Jan 1st, 1940    France either: Does not exist  Has capitulated  Has surrendered     Poland does not exist or has capitulated
true_blitzkrieg.requirements_ja: 1940年1月1日までにポーランド、フランスを降伏させる
true_blitzkrieg.notes_en: Both nations need to be either capitulated or annexed. Neither of them can be a puppet.   For detailed strategies, see True Blitzkrieg
true_blitzkrieg.notes_ja: 史実におけるポーランド降伏は1939年9月28日、フランス降伏は1940年6月22日
true_blitzkrieg.tsv_name: True Blitzkrieg（真の電撃戦） As Germany have both Poland and France surrender before January 1st 1940.

northern_light.requirements_en: Is a faction leader   In faction with:    Norway   Denmark   Sweden   Finland
northern_light.requirements_ja: 北欧諸国で陣営を作り、デンマーク、ノルウェー、スウェーデン、フィンランドを所属させる。
northern_light.notes_en: Oh historical mode, play as  Finland. Wait for world tension to reach 50% so you can do the Northern Defense Front national focus, which makes a faction and invites the other Scandinavian countries to it. The AI should join if it is not already in a faction.
northern_light.tsv_name: Northern Light（北極光） As a Scandinavian country form your own faction, and have Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland in it.

the_revolution_triumphant.requirements_en: Germany is a puppet of the  Soviet Union
the_revolution_triumphant.requirements_ja:
ソ連で、ドイツを傀儡化する
（東西ドイツはカウントしない。『ドイツ』タグでの傀儡化が必要）
the_revolution_triumphant.notes_en: Follow the historical route, or immediately declare war on  Poland and then  Germany.
the_revolution_triumphant.tsv_name: The Revolution Triumphant（革命の凱旋） Have Germany as a puppet of Soviet.

once_more_mate.requirements_ja: オーストラリアで、ガリポリ（イスタンブール）を占領する
once_more_mate.notes_en: You need to move your fleet into the Black Sea before Turkey remilitarises the Bosphorus Strait. You can increase its range by basing it in Cyprus. Go down the Empower the Workers path towards Join Comintern. Justify a wargoal on  Turkey and attack from the  Soviet Union. Turkey will guard Istanbul, but leave Erdine undefended. Call them into the war and naval invade Edirne (341). The achievement only requires control of the state, so it can be gained while at war.
once_more_mate.notes_ja: ガリポリ上陸作戦（ダーダネルス戦役）から
once_more_mate.tsv_name: Once More Mate（繰り返す片割れ） Occupy Gallipoli as Australia.

forge_of_victory.requirements_ja: ベルギーで、50以上の工場を持つ
forge_of_victory.notes_en: Naval dockyards count toward total factories. Simply go Fascist and conquer  Netherlands and  Luxembourg. If you end up at war with the Allies, don't worry. Simply join the Axis. When  Germany punches into  France through your territory and capitulates them, you will occupy all of  France, thus giving you the necessary factories.
forge_of_victory.tsv_name: Forge of Victory（勝利の鉄工所） Have 50 factories as Belgium.

sunset_invasion.requirements_en: Has joined a faction with non-South American members   Controls any coastal state on the European continent
sunset_invasion.requirements_ja: メキシコでヨーロッパの海岸を1州占領する。南アメリカ以外の同盟や傀儡は禁止。(枢軸とかはいると失敗する)
sunset_invasion.notes_en: You only need to occupy the state. Turn fascist and justify on  Denmark. Build ~10 submarines and declare war. Capture a port in Greenland and then invade  Iceland. Note that you cannot be in a faction with countries outside South America.
sunset_invasion.notes_ja: 同名のCK2DLCより。なお内容はハイパーアステカがヨーロッパに攻めてくるトンチキDLC
sunset_invasion.tsv_name: Sunset Invasion（サンセット・インベーション） Occupy a coastal province in Europe as Mexico, and if in a faction have it contain only South American members or puppets.

duce_nukedem.requirements_en: Ruling party is Fascist   Has dropped a nuclear bomb in California
duce_nukedem.requirements_ja: ファシスト・イタリアで、ロサンゼルスに核を落とす
duce_nukedem.notes_en: After securing the Mediterranean, it can easily be done with a small 1944 strategic bomber fleet (without any escort) by taking control of Gibraltar (118), Azores (698), and Bermuda (696).
duce_nukedem.notes_ja: FPSのDUKE NUKEM（デューク・ニューケム）より
duce_nukedem.tsv_name: Duce Nuked'em（ドゥーチェ・ニュークドム） Nuke Los Angeles as fascist Italy.

operation_sealion.requirements_en: Controls:     South-West England (123)  Sussex (127)  Gloucestershire (338)  Greater London Area (126)  East Anglia (125)  Wales (122)  West Midlands (128)  East Midlands (129)  Lancashire (132)  Yorkshire (130)  Northumberland (131)  Lanark (133)  Lothian (121)  Aberdeenshire (136)  Scottish Highlands (120)
operation_sealion.requirements_ja: ドイツで、グレートブリテン島を支配する。ちなみに北アイルランドは占領しなくても良い
operation_sealion.notes_en: Simply follow the guide for True Blitzkrieg which will put Western Europe under your control. At this point, it should be easy to launch an invasion on Yorkshire (130) and Northumberland (131). Get intel on the  United Kingdom or call  Italy into the war to help with gaining naval superiority. The British Isles will be weakly defended, and once you have a stable port beachhead, it should be trivial to conquer them.
operation_sealion.notes_ja: 元ネタは、史実で計画されたが実行されなかったドイツによるイギリス上陸作戦
operation_sealion.tsv_name: 【アシカ作戦】 Operation Sea Lion Control British mainland as Germany.

one_empire.requirements_en: Is a faction leader   Every state in the world is controlled by you or a member of your faction
one_empire.requirements_ja: イギリスで、世界中全ての国家を、支配下、傀儡国、同盟国のいずれかにする
one_empire.notes_en: This is achievement requires a lot of grinding. Go Fascist and keep the empire from falling apart. Take out the  United States early and give their territory to Canada to form the  Dominion of North America. Later forming the  Imperial Federation will then also include the US, giving one of the highest core population possible in the game, especially after also integrating Europe by forming the  European Federation. Make sure to justify on as many smaller countries as possible while at war with a major power to speed up the process. Pairs well with New World Order.
one_empire.tsv_name: One Empire（一つの帝国） Unite the entire world under the British Empire.

party_like_its_1520.requirements_en: Controls Södermanland (141)   Ruling party is Communist
party_like_its_1520.requirements_ja: コミュニスト・デンマークで、ストックホルムを占領する
party_like_its_1520.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see Party like it's 1520
party_like_its_1520.notes_ja: 元ネタは、1520年にデンマーク王が当時デンマーク領だったスウェーデンの独立派に対し和解しようと言って、誘い出して粛清した「ストックホルムの血浴」という事件
party_like_its_1520.tsv_name: 【1520年のような集まりを】 Party like it's 1520 Occupy Stockholm as communist Denmark.

montezumas_revenge.requirements_en: Controls:   California (378)  Nevada (379)  Utah (380)  Arizona (377)  New Mexico (376)  Texas (375)
montezumas_revenge.notes_en: Rush fascist and justify a war goal on the  Philippines, drawing in the  US. Train a lot of cavalry divisions and try to poke holes in the US line and encircle their troops. They should not have enough divisions to cover the entire border sufficiently.
montezumas_revenge.tsv_name: The Revenge of Montezuma Restore the old borders with the USA as Mexico.

big_entente.requirements_en: Is a faction leader   Has completed focus Strengthen the Little Entente   You or a member of your faction owns all cores of  Germany
big_entente.requirements_ja: フランスで、小協商の国家方針を全て完了し（ポーランドへの独立保障まで）ドイツを小協商内で保有する。（もし政体変更とかされると同盟入らないので実質失敗）
big_entente.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see Big Entente
big_entente.notes_ja: 小協商という第一次世界大戦後に成立されたチェコスロバキア、ユーゴスラビア、ルーマニアの同盟を掛けたシャレ
big_entente.tsv_name: Big Entente（大協商） As France, complete the "Little Entente" National Focus, and have all German cores owned by you or someone in your faction.

new_world_order.requirements_en: Ruling party of every country is Fascist
new_world_order.requirements_ja: 全世界のイデオロギーをファシズムに染める
new_world_order.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see New World Order
new_world_order.notes_ja: 元ネタはナチスが構想した戦後の新秩序。
new_world_order.tsv_name: New World Order（新世界秩序） Make all nations fascist.

vojtek_commander.requirements_ja:
ヒント：ポーランドで始める
ポーランドで
国家方針のArtillery_modernisationを取得
中立主義
ソビエトと派閥を組まない(傀儡にするのもダメ)
イタリアと戦争中
Hamadanをコントロールしている(ポーランドかポーランドの同盟国が)
Latium,Abruzzo,Tuscanyのどれかにポーランド兵がいる
MTTH30dでイベント発生で実績獲得
vojtek_commander.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see Bearer of Artillery
vojtek_commander.notes_ja: 元ネタは熊のヴォイテク。
vojtek_commander.tsv_name: Bearer of Artillery（大砲の持ち手） Gain Vojtek as commander

brains.requirements_en: Has completed focus Send in the Zombies
brains.requirements_ja: カナダで、国家方針「ゾンビを送れ」を完了する。
brains.notes_en: Play historical and rush down economic focuses. When  Germany declares war on  Poland, join the war and rush down to Send in the Zombies.
brains.notes_ja: 元ネタはボーダーランズの脳みそクエスト
brains.tsv_name: Braaaaains!（脳みそォォ！） As Canada, complete the Send in the Zombies focus.

district_9.requirements_en: At least 9 civilian factories in Transvaal (275)
district_9.requirements_ja: 南アフリカで、トランスヴァールに9つの民需工場を持つ。
district_9.notes_en: Convert military factories into civilian factories in Transvaal. Follow the Focus tree for free civilian factories. They can randomly give Transvaal the required Factories. If Transvaal runs out of building slots, follow the Dispersed/Concentrated Industry tech tree to get more building slots.
district_9.notes_ja: 元ネタは南アフリカを舞台にした映画『第9地区』
district_9.tsv_name: District 9（第9地区） As South Africa, have 9 civilian factories in Transvaal.

our_words_are_backed.requirements_en: One of the following must be true: Has completed focus Self Rule - Purna Swaraj   Has completed focus Quit India Movement    Has used a nuclear bomb
our_words_are_backed.requirements_ja: インドで、国家精神「インドから去れ運動」を持った状態で核攻撃を実行する。
our_words_are_backed.notes_en: With with Graveyard of Empires disabled, head for Quit India Movement and develop, build and deploy a nuclear bomb (remember to get some strategic bombers and fighters for air superiority). Potential targets include  Romania once  Turkey joins the Allies or  Siam once they join  Japan.
our_words_are_backed.notes_ja: 元ネタはターン制シミュレーションゲーム『Civlization』の核をぶっ放しまくるインド
our_words_are_backed.tsv_name: Our Words Are Backed With Nuclear Weapons（我らの言葉の裏に核兵器あり） As India, develop and deploy a nuke. You must have the Quit India Movement national spirit.

crusader_kings.requirements_ja: 南アフリカで、国家方針「我らに王を」を完了し、エルサレムを占領する。
crusader_kings.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see Crusader Kings IV
crusader_kings.notes_ja: 中世を舞台にしたパラド開発のゲーム『Crusader Kings』
crusader_kings.tsv_name: Crusader Kings（クルセイダーキングス） IV Take Jerusalem as Ethiopia and move the capital there

rule_britannia.play_as: either:     Australia   British Raj   Canada   New Zealand   South Africa
rule_britannia.requirements_en: Is fully independent   Controls:    South-West England (123)  Sussex (127)  Gloucestershire (338)  Greater London Area (126)  East Anglia (125)  Wales (122)  West Midlands (128)  East Midlands (129)  Lancashire (132)  Yorkshire (130)  Northumberland (131)  Lanark (133)  Lothian (121)  Aberdeenshire (136)  Scottish Highlands (120)
rule_britannia.requirements_ja: イギリスの従属国で、グレートブリテン島と北アイルランドを占領する。
rule_britannia.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see Rule Britannia
rule_britannia.notes_ja:
元ネタはイギリス第二の国歌『ルール・ブリタニア』
本来の歌詞は「Rule,Britannia!(統べよ！ブリタニア)」だが、カンマ無しの「Rule Britannia」だとそのまま他動詞+目的語として訳し「ブリタニアを支配せよ」という真逆の意味（つまり実績内容と同義）になるという、悪い冗談である。
EU4にも同名のDLCがある。
rule_britannia.tsv_name: Rule Britannia（ブリタニアを統べよ） As any British Subject state, conquer all of Britain.

cut_the_strings.other_conditions: Is a puppet of another country
cut_the_strings.requirements_ja: 初期の傀儡国で、宗主国から独立する。
cut_the_strings.notes_en: As  Manchukuo, rush down the Assertiveness path towards Independence War.
cut_the_strings.notes_ja:
連合国陣営では該当するのはインドと英領マラヤ。他構成国は全て「自治領」であるので対象外。データ集/傀儡の自治システム参照。
他にはフィリピンや蘭印や蒙古国、満州国(要WTT)も該当。
cut_the_strings.tsv_name: Cut The Strings（紐を切る） Break free from your overlord as a puppet.

its_1812_all_over_again.requirements_ja: カナダで、ワシントンD.C.を獲得する。
its_1812_all_over_again.notes_en: Pick Patriation and Swastika Clubs as your first focuses. Go for Support a Synarchist Baja when you switch, get  Mexico in your faction and attack the  United States on the East Coast.
its_1812_all_over_again.notes_ja:
元ネタは1812年戦争。
この戦争でイギリス軍にワシントンD.C.は占領され大統領府もろとも焼き討ちされた、この焼かれた議事堂が後にホワイトハウスとなる。
its_1812_all_over_again.tsv_name: It's 1812 All Over Again（これぞ1812年のやり直し） As Canada, take and hold Washington D.C.

the_weapons_of_the_third_emu_war.requirements_en: Has dropped nuke on core Australian territory
the_weapons_of_the_third_emu_war.requirements_ja: オーストラリアで、オーストラリアの中核州において核爆弾を使う。
the_weapons_of_the_third_emu_war.notes_en: Invent and build fighters, strategic bombers and nukes. Wait for  Japan and let them conquer one state, which you should nuke. Use your own fighters or wait for the Allies to help with air superiority.
the_weapons_of_the_third_emu_war.notes_ja:
オーストラリアはエミューの討伐をしようと大規模な軍事行動を二度行っている。
英語圏のネットでは「オーストラリアはエミューと戦争して敗北した」というのが定番のネタである。
the_weapons_of_the_third_emu_war.tsv_name: The weapons of the Third Emu War（第三次エミュー戦争の兵器） As Australia, use a nuclear bomb on core Australian territory.

i_am_the_tong_master.requirements_en: Is fully independent   Has at least one subject
i_am_the_tong_master.requirements_ja: 南アフリカで、イギリスから独立し、他の国家を傀儡化する。
i_am_the_tong_master.notes_en: Release  Namibia as your puppet when the game starts.
i_am_the_tong_master.notes_ja: 南西アフリカが初期から非中核州としてあるので、共産化してから傀儡開放で簡単に達成できる。
i_am_the_tong_master.tsv_name: I Am the Tong Master（我こそトングの使い手） As South Africa, break free from the UK and puppet another nation.

the_empire_strikes_back.requirements_en: At war with either:   South Africa   Canada   British Raj   Australia   New Zealand   British Malaya
the_empire_strikes_back.requirements_ja: イギリスで、南アフリカ、カナダ、インド、オーストラリア、ニュージーランド、マレーシアのいずれかの国に宣戦布告する。
the_empire_strikes_back.notes_en: Go for any sub-branch of the tree under A Change in Course branch. The Dominions will break ties with you. Simply declare war on one of them.
the_empire_strikes_back.notes_ja: 『スター・ウォーズ エピソード5/帝国の逆襲』（STAR WARS EPISODE V:THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK）
the_empire_strikes_back.tsv_name: The Empire Strikes Back（帝国の逆襲） As Britain, declare war on one of your former subjects.

the_puppetmaster.notes_en: Play as Communist  Britain and declare war on  France. Puppet as many of their colonies as possible. Then, go down the Revisit Colonial Policy branch of your focus tree, releasing a lot of subjects.
the_puppetmaster.notes_ja:
に俺はなる！
ではなく、メタルバンドMetallicaの代表曲「Master of Puppets」が元ネタかと思われる。
Obay your masterという歌詞の意味が「神にひれ伏せ」から「クスリに屈服しろ」に変わる。
英国が起こしたアヘン戦争をひっかけているのでは、と思われる。
the_puppetmaster.tsv_name: The Puppetmaster（パペットマスター） Have at least 51 subjects.

freegypt.requirements_en: Is  Egypt   Reached Colony Status   Reached Dominion Status   Reached Freedom Status
freegypt.requirements_ja: イギリスもしくは他の国で、エジプトを解放させ、「解放された国としてプレイ」を選択した後に自治権システムを使って自主独立する。
freegypt.notes_en: Start as the  United Kingdom and build up Egypt as much as possible. Once completely full of military factories, release  Egypt as a puppet (check "Play as" when the checkbox appears). Increase your autonomy in any way possible: lend lease (trains and convoys are excellent), continuous focus and attaché.
freegypt.notes_ja: 自由とエジプトを引っ掛けただけ
freegypt.tsv_name: 【フリージプト！】 Freegypt As Egypt, go from puppet to a free nation using the autonomy system.

better_than_the_szent_istvan.notes_en: With Götterdämmerung, you must complete the End the Regency to get Horthy as an advisor. Otherwise, you must complete Invite the Habsburg Prince. After that, you can go for any path under Reinstate the Pragmatic Sanction of 1713 to get wargoals on  Yugoslavia or  Romania. Build up your industry and army, conquer either one, research and deploy a battleship and assign Horthy to that fleet.
better_than_the_szent_istvan.tsv_name: Better than the Szent István As Hungary, have Miklos Horthy as a Naval commander and build a battleship.

death_or_dishonor_or_cake.requirements_ja: カロル2世が政府首班のルーマニアで、「パーティはお開きの時間だ」「退位を強制」「王の手綱を握る」のいずれも取得していない状態でゲーム開始時に隣接しているすべての国家*2の中核州を最低1つずつ領有する。
death_or_dishonor_or_cake.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see Death or Dishonor or Cake
death_or_dishonor_or_cake.notes_ja: カロル2世が国外逃避していた時に即位した息子ミハイ1世（5歳）は、家臣に王であることを告げられた時に「ほんとに？」と言い、本当だと言われるとチョコレートケーキをねだった。
death_or_dishonor_or_cake.tsv_name: Death or Dishonor or Cake（死か屈辱かケーキか） As Romania, own a slice of all your starting neighbors.

neither_death_nor_dishonor.requirements_en: Has lost a starting state   Controls either Moscow (219) or Brandenburg (64)   After 31st Dec, 1941

neither_death_nor_dishonor.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see Neither Death nor Dishonor
neither_death_nor_dishonor.tsv_name: Neither Death nor Dishonor（死でも屈辱でもない） As Romania, make it to 1942 with all the states you started it with and control either Moscow or Berlin.

the_munich_disagreement.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see The Munich Disagreement
the_munich_disagreement.tsv_name: The Munich Disagreement（ミュンヘン不合意） As Czechoslovakia, occupy Munich while at war with Germany.

czechmate.requirements_en: At war with  United Kingdom   Ruling party of  United Kingdom is Democratic   Controls New South Wales (285)
czechmate.requirements_ja: チェコスロヴァキアで、連合国と戦争中にキャンベラ(オーストラリア首都)を占領する。
czechmate.notes_ja: チェスの詰みであるチェックメイト（checkmate）を引っ掛けただけ
czechmate.tsv_name: Czechmate（チェッコメイト） As Czechoslovakia, occupy Canberra while at war with the Allies.

huge_oslavia.notes_en: The achievement only requires control of the state, so it can be gained while at war.   For detailed strategies, see Huge-oslavia
huge_oslavia.notes_ja: そのまま「でかいスラブ」の意味。ユーゴスラビアが南スラブを意味することから。
huge_oslavia.tsv_name: Huge-oslavia（ヒュージオスラビア） As Yugoslavia, occupy all your neighbouring countries (Austria, Hungary, Romania, Bulgaria, Albania, Italy and Greece).

the_balkan_powder_keg.requirements_en: Declared war on Axis or Allies while in either Axis or Allies
the_balkan_powder_keg.requirements_ja: ユーゴスラビアで、枢軸国か連合国に加入してる時に別陣営に宣戦する。
the_balkan_powder_keg.notes_en: Choose fascist demagogue as your first Political Power spending, turn fascist (skip civil war option), complete Invite German Military Mission and join the Axis. Justify and declare war on the  UK.  If playing on historical, signing the Tripartite pact will cause a civil war. So just flip via decision and join the axis manually.
the_balkan_powder_keg.notes_ja: 言わずと知れた「ヨーロッパの火薬庫」
the_balkan_powder_keg.tsv_name: The Balkan Powder Keg（バルカン火薬庫） As Yugoslavia, start the Second World War (i.e. be part of either the Axis or the Allies and at war with the other faction in a war you started).

en_svensk_tiger.requirements_en: Is licensing from  Germany either:  Heavy Tank II (Panzerkampfwagen VI Tiger)  Heavy Tank III (Panzerkampfwagen Tiger Ausf. B)  Improved Heavy Tank Chassis  Advanced Heavy Tank Chassis
en_svensk_tiger.requirements_ja: スウェーデンで、ドイツからティーガー(1941重戦車)、もしくはティーガー II(1943重戦車)の生産ライセンスを貰う。
en_svensk_tiger.notes_en: Choose the fascist demagogue as your first advisor and turn fascist. Avoid civil war if possible. Join the Axis and help them in their wars.  Germany has to survive until they research Tiger tank - at least late 1943.  Note: Due to a bug, this achievement cannot be obtained with the No Step Back enabled, because Germany never progresses beyond "Basic Heavy Tank", no matter how long you wait.
en_svensk_tiger.notes_ja:
スウェーデン語のtigerには「虎」と「黙る」の2つの意味があり、"En Svensk Tiger"は「スウェーデンの虎」と「スウェーデン人は喋らない」のダブルミーニングになっている。元ネタは第二次大戦中にスウェーデン政府が行った啓発活動のスローガンで、国情をナチスのスパイに漏らすのを防ぐために、虎のマスコットキャラを作っておしゃべりを慎むよう呼び掛けた。
DLCが入っているとドイツがモジュール等の研究に追われ該当重戦車を研究せず取れない場合がある その場合はDLCを全部外してみよう
en_svensk_tiger.tsv_name: En Svensk Tiger（エン・スヴェンスク・ティーゲル） As Sweden, acquire a production license for a Tiger or Tiger II tank from Germany.

lethal_straight.requirements_en: Is licensing from 5 of the below:   United Kingdom   Germany   United States   Soviet Union   Japan   France   Italy
lethal_straight.requirements_ja: 7大国(外交画面での主要国)のうち5国からライセンスを貰う。
lethal_straight.notes_en: It is recommended to play as a non-aligned nation to avoid the diplomatic penalty from different ideology which may block the “Request License Production” option. Improve relations with five of the seven major powers then license the basic infantry weapons. (Researching the next level of infantry equipment also works, as even major nations have few problems with licensing outdated equipment).   With La Résistance, you can use an agent and assign him to put diplomatic pressure on majors as well.
lethal_straight.notes_ja: ポーカーの役ロイヤル・ストレート
lethal_straight.tsv_name: Lethal Straight（リーサル・ストレート） Have a production license from at least 5 of the 7 major powers.

awake_and_angry.requirements_en: Japan was forced to sue for peace after losing all of Manchuria and Korea   Owns all core states of  China and  Manchukuo except Kouang-Tchéou-Wan (728), Macau (729), and Hong Kong (326)
awake_and_angry.requirements_ja: 中華民国で、全中国と満州を再征服し、日本を降伏させる。
awake_and_angry.notes_en: Note: You do not need to conquer Kouang-Tchéou-Wan (728), Macau (729), and Hong Kong (326) for this achievement. Therefore, this can be achieved without ever going to war against the Allies.     For detailed strategies, see Awake and Angry
awake_and_angry.tsv_name: Awake and Angry（覚醒と怒り） As China, reconquer all of China and Manchuria and force a Japanese surrender.

romance_of_the_three_kingdoms.requirements_en: Integrated the Guanxi Clique through making them a puppet   Integrated Yunnan through making them a puppet
romance_of_the_three_kingdoms.requirements_ja: 中華民国で、雲南・広西軍閥を傀儡化した後併合する。
romance_of_the_three_kingdoms.notes_en: Play on non-historical and ensure  Japan goes for Support the Kodoha Faction. Take Subjugate the Warlords. If they do not accept peacefully, use your war goals to puppet them by force. Complete the series of "Integrate the Warlords" decisions which appear after  Guangxi Clique and  Yunnan are puppetted. Alternatively, defeat them the old-fashioned way (possibly after taking "One China Policy" focus) and then reduce their autonomy by building stuff (including border-to-border level 5 forts and supply depots) on their territories and/or lend-leasing supplies to them. The achievement can even be done by annexing them in a war, releasing them as puppets, and then reintegrating them (in case "puppet" is not an available option in the peace conference.)
romance_of_the_three_kingdoms.notes_ja:
言わずもがな180年～280年頃の中国における魏・呉・蜀の三国時代が元ネタ
中華民国(魏)・広西軍閥(呉)・雲南(蜀)
romance_of_the_three_kingdoms.tsv_name: Romance of the Three Kingdoms（三国志） As China, puppet and then annex Yunnan and Guangxi Clique.

sun_tzu_reborn.play_as: either:    China   Chinese Soviet Republic   Guangxi Clique   Yunnan   Shanxi   Xibei San Ma   Qinghai Ma   Sinkiang   Khotan Ma   Ningxia Ma   Gansu Ma   Sichuan Clique   Guangdong Clique   Northeastern Army   Shandong Clique   Hebei-Chahar   Reorganized National Government   Kumul Khanate
sun_tzu_reborn.requirements_en: Any army leader:  Is a field Marshal  Skill Level more than 8
sun_tzu_reborn.requirements_ja: いずれかの中国国家で、レベル9の元帥を誕生させる。
sun_tzu_reborn.notes_en: As  Chinese Soviet Republic, play on non-historical in order to prevent the Sino-Japanese war ( Japan going communist is ideal). Make a fallback line on your capital and declare an early war on  China while holding your capital with 9-12 divisions. Research infantry equipment and artillery only (at some point some of your divisions may run out of organization and die, so deploy a few extra divisions before it happens). If the AI stops attacking you, bait it to attack by training your divisions. If a General becomes level 9 before your field marshal, you may promote the General to field marshal and you will get the achievement.
sun_tzu_reborn.notes_ja: 孫子は兵法書『孫子』の著者
sun_tzu_reborn.tsv_name: Sun Tzu Reborn（孫子の再誕） As Any Chinese Nation, have a level 9 field marshal.

the_people_have_stood_up.notes_ja: 「中国人民站起来了（ジョングオ・レンミン・ジャンチライ・ラ）」は1949年に毛沢東が発した有名な建国宣言
the_people_have_stood_up.tsv_name: The People Have Stood Up!（人民は立ち上がった！） With Mao as your leader, win the Chinese Civil War.

made_in_china.notes_en: Simply follow the guide for The People Have Stood Up! and build a lot of military factories in your territory.  Note: Offmap military factories do not count.

tojo_shot_first.requirements_ja: 日本で、アメリカが核兵器を開発する前に、アメリカの中核州に核を撃ち込む。
tojo_shot_first.notes_en: Follow the strategy for Sunrise Invasion. When you have nukes, release the  US and go to war with them. The US must control the state you drop the nuke in.
tojo_shot_first.notes_ja:
元ネタは映画『スター・ウォーズ』でハン・ソロがグリードを射殺するシーン
「ハンが先に撃った」というフレーズは、このシーンを巡る有名な論議を指すと同時に、議論の結論でもある。
tojo_shot_first.tsv_name: Tojo Shot First（東條が先に撃った） As Japan, Nuke a core territory of the US before the US develops nuclear weapons.

sunrise_invasion.requirements_en: Before 1 Jan, 1945   Annexed Mexico before taking any territory in Europe   Owns a coastal state in Europe
sunrise_invasion.requirements_ja: 日本で、1945年以前にメキシコを征服し、その後ヨーロッパを征服する。
sunrise_invasion.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see Sunrise Invasion
sunrise_invasion.notes_ja: メキシコの実績「サンセット・インベーション」の日出国版
sunrise_invasion.tsv_name: Sunrise Invasion（サンライズ・インベーション） As Japan, conquer Mexico then Europe before 1945.

the_dragon_swallowed_the_sun.requirements_ja: 満州国で、日本から独立し、陣営に所属していない状態で旧宗主国を征服する。
the_dragon_swallowed_the_sun.notes_en: Note: To get the achievement_the_dragon_swallowed_the_sun country flag, you must annex  Japan without being in a faction. The "not in a faction" check is done when Japan gets annexed, so theoretically you are free to join factions during the game if you want to, as long as you leave before you annex Japan. Remember that if you call your faction members to war, you will not be able to leave until after the peace conference.   For detailed strategies, see The Dragon Swallowed the Sun
the_dragon_swallowed_the_sun.notes_ja: 元ネタはチベットの独立運動を追ったアメリカのドキュメンタリー映画『When The Dragon Swallowed The Sun』
the_dragon_swallowed_the_sun.tsv_name: The Dragon Swallowed the Sun（日を飲む龍） As Manchukuo, Break free from Japan and annex your former Overlord without being in a faction.

hail_to_the_qing.requirements_en: Has completed focus Claim the Mandate of Heaven
hail_to_the_qing.requirements_ja: 満州国で、清朝を復古させる。
hail_to_the_qing.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see Hail to the Qing
hail_to_the_qing.notes_ja: 元ネタはアメリカのヘビメタバンド、アヴェンジド・セヴンフォールドのアルバム『Hail to the King（ヘイル・トゥ・ザ・キング）』
hail_to_the_qing.tsv_name: Hail to the Qing（清朝万歳） As Manchukuo, restore the Qing dynasty.

the_good_the_bad_and_the_weird.requirements_en: At least 5 infrastructure in:    Heilungkiang (714)  Liaobei (715)  Jehol (610)  Kirin (328)  Sungkiang (717)     At least 16 Oil
the_good_the_bad_and_the_weird.requirements_ja: 満州国で、すべての州のインフラを最大にし、最低でも15の石油を産出する。
the_good_the_bad_and_the_weird.notes_en: The needed oil can be generated entirely by Heilungkiang (714), once you have researched Excavation IV and done both Prospect for Resources decisions.
the_good_the_bad_and_the_weird.notes_ja:
元ネタは同名の韓国映画。満州を舞台とした韓国版西部劇。
さらにその元ネタは1966年の映画『The Good, the Bad and the Ugly（邦題：続・夕陽のガンマン）』である
the_good_the_bad_and_the_weird.tsv_name: The Good, the Bad and the Weird（グッド・バッド・ウィアード） As Manchukuo, have max level infrastructure in every owned state and generate at least 15 units of oil.

battlecry.play_as: either:    Guangxi Clique   Yunnan   Shanxi   Xibei San Ma   Qinghai Ma   Sinkiang   Khotan Ma   Ningxia Ma   Gansu Ma   Sichuan Clique   Guangdong Clique   Northeastern Army   Shandong Clique   Hebei-Chahar   Kumul Khanate
battlecry.requirements_en: Owns all core states of  China,  Manchukuo and  Japan except Kouang-Tchéou-Wan (728), Macau (729), and Hong Kong (326).
battlecry.requirements_ja: 軍閥で、全中国と日本を征服する。
battlecry.notes_ja:
「battle cry」は日本語で喊声（かんせい）、勝鬨（かちどき）の意
元ネタは 1941年に発表された日中戦争の記録映画 "Kukan（苦幹）, the battle cry of China"。前半部分は中華民国以外のさまざまな民族の抗日戦線への関わりが、後半部分は前年の重慶空爆の様子が記録されている。アカデミー名誉賞を受賞し、ルーズベルトがホワイトハウスで鑑賞した。
battlecry.tsv_name: Battlecry（バトルクライ） As a warlord, conquer all of China and Japan.

panda_monium.play_as: either:    Guangxi Clique   Yunnan   Shanxi   Xibei San Ma   Qinghai Ma   Sinkiang   Guangdong Clique   Shandong Clique   Sichuan Clique   Ningxia Ma   Gansu Ma   Northeastern Army   Khotan Ma   Kumul Khanate   Hebei-Chahar
panda_monium.requirements_en: At war with:     Guangxi Clique   Yunnan   Shanxi   Xibei San Ma   Sinkiang   China   Chinese Soviet Republic
panda_monium.requirements_ja: 軍閥で、すべての中国の国家と同時に戦争する。
panda_monium.notes_en: Play as  Sinkiang, join the Comintern, and justify and declare war on a warlord once the Chinese United Front is formed.   For detailed strategies, see Panda-monium
panda_monium.notes_ja: パンデモニウムとパンダ（中国の意）のダジャレ。
panda_monium.tsv_name: Panda-monium（パンダモニウム） As a warlord, be at war with all Chinese nations simultaneously.

make_a_man_out_of_you.play_as: either:    Guangxi Clique   Yunnan   Shanxi   Xibei San Ma   Qinghai Ma   Sinkiang   Guangdong Clique   Shandong Clique   Sichuan Clique   Ningxia Ma   Gansu Ma   Northeastern Army   Khotan Ma   Kumul Khanate   Hebei-Chahar
make_a_man_out_of_you.requirements_en: Has at least 1,000,000 manpower in deployment queue
make_a_man_out_of_you.requirements_ja: 軍閥で、少なくとも100万人の人的資源を配備可能な状態にする。
make_a_man_out_of_you.notes_en: Start as  Guangxi Clique and get to 5 Army experience, either by training or hiring military advisor. Create a 1 width division and rush train as many as possible (make sure to set it to the highest priority in the recruiting tab so it gets guns first). Deploy them as soon as they reach the minimum training level and just switch them to the normal template.  Note: You can only train 75% of the manpower currently on the field with a minimum of 100.00K. So that means you must have at least 1,333,334 manpower on the field to do this achievement.
make_a_man_out_of_you.notes_ja: 元ネタは古代中国を舞台にしたディズニー映画「ムーラン」の曲（I"ll Make a Man Out Of You）より
make_a_man_out_of_you.tsv_name: Make a Man Out Of You（お前を漢にしてやる） As a Warlord, have at least 1,000,000 manpower queued up for deployment.

monarchy_is_back_in_fashion.requirements_en: Wilhelm II is the current country leader    Italy has Vittorio Emanuele III as the current country leader
monarchy_is_back_in_fashion.requirements_ja: ドイツで、皇帝を帰国させ、ヴィルヘルムII世戴冠中にムッソリーニを暗殺してヴィットーリオ・エマヌエーレに支配させる。ヴィルヘルムIII世になるとダメ。
monarchy_is_back_in_fashion.notes_en: Requires Götterdämmerung disabled.  Follow the Return of the Kaiser and the Focus on the True Enemy path in the Oppose Hitler branch until you get to the Assassinate Mussolini focus (AI will always agree to assassinate Mussolini). Wilhelm II must be your leader and he must not die before the focus is complete. Note that you can get the achievement just by placing Wilhelm II in the German Empire throne if the non-historical AI choses without your intervention to get rid of Mussolini and place Victor Emmanuel as king.
monarchy_is_back_in_fashion.notes_ja: ファッショとファッションを掛けている
monarchy_is_back_in_fashion.tsv_name: Monarchy is Back In Fashion（ファッション君主制） As Germany, Bring back the Kaiser and ensure that Italy is controlled by Victor Emmanuel by killing Mussolini.

our_other_place_in_the_sun.requirements_en: If Götterdämmerung is enabled:  Has completed focus Our Place in the Sun   Otherwise:  Has completed focus Our Place in the Sun    Conquered an island in the Caribbean
our_other_place_in_the_sun.requirements_ja: 帝政ドイツで、カリブ海の島を征服する。
our_other_place_in_the_sun.notes_en: Requires  Germany to follow the Return of the Kaiser branch. Taking Curacao from the  Dutch will not earn the achievement, as it is counted as part of South America.   For detailed strategies, see Our Other Place in the Sun
our_other_place_in_the_sun.notes_ja: 元ネタはドイツ帝国の外相ビューローの言葉で、植民地獲得競争に乗り出したドイツ帝国の世界政策を端的に現す単語として知られている。
our_other_place_in_the_sun.tsv_name: Our Other Place in the Sun（新たな陽の当たる場所） As Imperial Germany, conquer a Caribbean island.

australia_hungary.requirements_ja: オーストラリアで、ハンガリーの中核州をすべて所有する。
australia_hungary.notes_ja: オーストラリア（Australia）とオーストリア（Austria）を間違えるのは万国共通のジョーク。
australia_hungary.tsv_name: Australia-Hungary（オーストラリア＝ハンガリー） As Australia, own all core territory of Hungary.

my_ships_dont_lie.requirements_en: Has taken the decision to form  Gran Colombia    At least 10 Battleships   At least 10 Carriers
my_ships_dont_lie.requirements_ja:
大コロンビアを形成し、主力艦を20隻保有する。
俺はビザンツ狂じゃない（I Swear I’m Not a Byzantophile）
ギリシャで、ビザンツ帝国を形成する。
my_ships_dont_lie.notes_en: Requires the Restore the Bolívar Union decision.   For detailed strategies, see My Ships Don't Lie

my_ships_dont_lie.tsv_name: My Ships Don't Lie（お船は嘘つかない） As Colombia, form Gran Colombia and have 10 Carriers and 10 Battleships.

team_america.requirements_en: Dropped a nuclear bomb on Paris
team_america.requirements_ja: アメリカで、パリに核を落とす。
team_america.notes_en: As a democratic nation, build a lot of planes, namely strategic bombers and fighters, and rush nuclear technology.  Germany will control Paris. When in the Allies, move your planes to the airfield on the  British Isles and set them on mission to Northern  France when the nuclear tech is ready and one nuke is available. Achieve air superiority and nuke Paris when ready.
team_america.notes_ja:
元ネタは同名の映画。サウスパーク制作陣による風刺コメディ。
国際警察「チーム・アメリカ」の活躍により、パリに潜む邪悪なアラブ人テロリスト達はパリの街もろとも撲滅されたのであった。
team_america.tsv_name: Team America（チーム★アメリカ） As the U.S.A., drop a nuclear bomb on Paris.

history_repeated_itself.requirements_en: The Second American Civil War has started    Confederacy of American States exists
history_repeated_itself.requirements_ja: アメリカで、第2次南北戦争でアメリカ連合国に勝利する。【要MtG】
history_repeated_itself.notes_en: Completing either Full Desegregation or Union Representation Act will trigger a civil war with the Confederacy. To help the  United States win the war, complete the WPA branch and Guarantee the American Dream beforehand.
history_repeated_itself.tsv_name: History Repeated Itself（歴史は繰り返す） As the U.S.A., Win against the Confederate States. Again.

georgia_on_my_mind.requirements_en: Owns and controls Georgia (365), Georgia (231), and South Georgia (720)
georgia_on_my_mind.requirements_ja: アメリカで、3つの"ジョージア"（ジョージア・グルジア・サウスジョージア）を占領する。
georgia_on_my_mind.notes_en: Collaborating with the Axis is the simplest route to achieving this. Help the Axis capitulate the Allies and the Comintern, and grab  South Georgia (720) and  Georgia (231). South Georgia (720) can also be obtained via the Reaffirm Monroe Doctrine focus.
georgia_on_my_mind.notes_ja:
「我が心のジョージア」は、ジャズのスタンダード・ナンバーの一つである。アメリカ・ジョージア州の州歌にもなっている。
ビートルズの曲「バック・イン・ザ・U.S.S.R.」にも同じフレーズが登場するように、ジョージアとグルジアを引っ掛けたジョークは古くからある。
EU4にも同名かつ、ほぼ同内容の実績が存在している。

to_arms_in_dixie.requirements_ja: アメリカで、アメリカ連合国（南部連合）として第2次南北戦争を始める。【要MtG】
to_arms_in_dixie.notes_en: Complete America First and hire the fascist advisor. When ready and possible, complete Ally With the Silver Shirts to trigger the event chain leading to the civil war. For best results, complete Work With the Bund and Recruit the Free Corps.
to_arms_in_dixie.notes_ja: ディキシー（Dixie）はアメリカ合衆国南部諸州の通称。"To Arms in Dixie!"はアメリカ連合国の（非公式）国歌『ディキシーの国（Dixie's Land）』のバリエーションのうち、軍歌版のサビ。
to_arms_in_dixie.tsv_name: To Arms in Dixie!（ディキシー戦闘準備！） As the U.S.A., start a new civil war as the South.

arsenal_of_democracy.requirements_en: Ruling party is Democratic   More than 300 military factories
arsenal_of_democracy.requirements_ja: アメリカで、300より多い軍需工場を持つ。
arsenal_of_democracy.notes_en: The easiest way to earn this achievement is to simply play on historical as the  United States and build as many Military factories as possible. The Arsenal of Democracy branch of the focus tree gives Military factories for free, so make sure you complete it, along with the WPA branch to boost your industry.
arsenal_of_democracy.notes_ja: 元ネタはフランクリン・ルーズベルトの有名な演説より。
arsenal_of_democracy.tsv_name: Arsenal of Democracy（民主主義の兵器廠） As the U.S.A., have more than 300 military factories.

underpaid_undersexed_and_under_eisenhowe.requirements_en: Is in faction with the  United Kingdom   Is Faction leader   Received at least 50 expeditionary forces from the  United Kingdom
underpaid_undersexed_and_under_eisenhowe.requirements_ja: アメリカで、連合国の盟主となり、イギリスから50個師団より多くの遠征軍を得る。【要MtG】
underpaid_undersexed_and_under_eisenhowe.notes_en: Simply play historical and join the Allies. You need 50% more factories and fielded manpower than the  United Kingdom, which shouldn't be a problem after a few years of buildup. Once you become faction leader, create an invasion order and press the button below the army to request 51 expeditionary forces and earn the achievement.   Note: The UK will accept to send the 51 divisions you need if they have ~160 divisions, you can send them some of your own troops as expeditionary forces to get them past that number.
underpaid_undersexed_and_under_eisenhowe.notes_ja:
戦時下の不景気なイギリスにおいて、ヒーロー気取りでイギリス人女性を侍らす陽気なアメリカ人は、イギリス人男性にとっては鼻につく存在であった。
イギリス人はアメリカ兵を「overpaid, overfed, oversexed and over here」、アメリカ兵はイギリス人を「underpaid, undersexed and under Eisenhower」とお互い貶しあったらしい。
underpaid_undersexed_and_under_eisenhowe.tsv_name: Underpaid, Undersexed, and Under Eisenhower（ケチでインポなアイゼンハワーのしもべ（Underpaid, Undersexed, and Under Eisenhower ））） As the U.S.A., assume faction leadership of the Allies, and have over 50 expeditionary divisions from the United Kingdom.

last_for_a_thousand_years.requirements_ja: イギリスで、完全な大英帝国の連邦化を達成する。（NF帝国連邦）【要MtG】
last_for_a_thousand_years.notes_en: Can be done as any ideology. Make sure to improve relations and save up a few hundred Political Power before starting Hold the Imperial Conference. 300-400 political power is a good number to have saved before starting but if you can spare the time and effort, having around 600-700 political power will ensure success.
last_for_a_thousand_years.notes_ja: チャーチルの1940年6月18日の演説「だからこそ我らの責務に身を引き締め、大英帝国と英連邦が千年続いたのちにもなお『このころが一番よかった』と言われるように振舞おうではないか（Let us therefore brace ourselves to our duty, and so bear ourselves that if the British Empire and its Commonwealth last for a thousand years, men will still say, "This was their finest hour".）」より。パリ陥落の5日後。
last_for_a_thousand_years.tsv_name: Last for a Thousand Years（千年間にもわたり） As the United Kingdom, accomplish the federation of the entire British Empire.

britzkrieg.requirements_en: Has completed focus The King's Party   Is in faction with  Germany    France has capitulated or does not exist   Has full control of Ile de France (16)
britzkrieg.requirements_ja: イギリスで、エドワード8世を元首にドイツと同盟し、パリを完全に支配する。【要MtG】
britzkrieg.notes_en: Follow the focus tree to Alliance with Germany. Justify against  France and launch a naval invasion of Normandy. It is not necessary to call  Germany into the war. If France is puppeted, the achievement will not fire. Annex all cores, territories, and colonies to be sure.
britzkrieg.notes_ja: ドイツの電撃戦（ブリッツクリーク：Blitzkrieg）にイギリス（British）を掛けたシャレ
britzkrieg.tsv_name: Britzkrieg（イギリス電撃戦） As the United Kingdom, put Edward VIII in power, ally Germany and fully control Paris.

nothing_wrong_with_our_bloody_ships.requirements_ja: イギリスで、9隻の巡洋戦艦を保有する。
nothing_wrong_with_our_bloody_ships.notes_en: Battlecruisers are built with "Heavy Ship Hulls" and "Battlecruiser armor". Make the cheapest battlecruisers you can and build 6 at the same time ( United Kingdom start with 3) with all your dockyards assigned, build more dockyards to speed up construction.
nothing_wrong_with_our_bloody_ships.notes_ja:
元ネタはイギリス海軍の巡洋戦艦艦隊を率いたデイヴィッド・ビーティー提督のユトランド沖海戦での言葉。
「血塗られた我が艦隊に今日は少し問題があるようだ（there seems to be something wrong with our bloody ships today）」
ユトランド沖海戦では2隻を失いながらも決定的勝利を手にし、その後、海軍元帥となった。
nothing_wrong_with_our_bloody_ships.tsv_name: Nothing Wrong with our Bloody Ships（血塗られた我が艦隊に異常なし） As the United Kingdom, have at least 9 battlecruisers.

william_wallis.requirements_en: Has completed focus The King's Party    Scotland is a subject of The  United Kingdom   The  United States is a subject of The  United Kingdom   Installed an American monarchy

william_wallis.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see William Wallis
william_wallis.notes_ja:

crush_the_dream.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see Crush the Dream
crush_the_dream.notes_ja: 夢とはアメリカンドリームを意味する。アメリカンドリーム、即ち、勤勉と努力によって勝者になるという資本主義的な幸福追求の権利を、共産主義によって根底から打ち砕くことを意味する。

treading_the_narrow_path.requirements_en: Has completed focus Cave to the Germans   Has completed focus Continue the Zuiderzee Works   Lost one of your starting states   After 1st Jan, 1945

putting_the_raid_on_the_medway_to_shame.requirements_en: The  United Kingdom has no capital ships

putting_the_raid_on_the_medway_to_shame.tsv_name: Putting the Raid on the Medway to Shame（メドウェイ川襲撃なんて目じゃない（Putting the Raid on the Medway to Shame )） As the Netherlands, ensure the United Kingdom has no capital ships (carriers, battleships, battlecruisers, or heavy cruisers).

bevrijding.requirements_en: Ruling party is Democratic   Has completed focus Liberation
bevrijding.requirements_ja: オランダで、政府を東インド諸島に移した後、再びオランダを解放する。【要MtG】
bevrijding.notes_en: Simply play as  Netherlands on Historical, and go down the Continue the War in Batavia branch. There is no point in trying to defend your European lands (as Continue the War in Batavia requires you to have capitulated), so build up your Asian possessions. Once  Germany is defeated, you will have control of your homeland back, and you can complete Liberation and earn the achievement.   Note: You will need to have removed the "Shell-shocked Spectator of the Great War" spirit, so make sure you complete War on Pacifism as soon as possible.
bevrijding.notes_ja: オランダ語で「解放」の意であるが、ドイツの占領からのベネルクス3国の解放を指す固有名詞として広く使われる。
bevrijding.tsv_name: Bevrijding（べヴレイディンフ） As the Netherlands, liberate the continental Netherlands after relocating the government to the East Indies.

mi_casa_es_tu_casa.requirements_en: Any country is exiled in  Mexico
mi_casa_es_tu_casa.requirements_ja: メキシコで、どこかの国の亡命政府を受け入れる。【要MtG】
mi_casa_es_tu_casa.notes_en: To host a government in exile you need to be the leader of a faction which has the rule "allows hosting exiled governments". Both the Hispanic and Bolivarian Alliance factions that mexico can create only allow Hispanic countries to join. Since historically no hispanic country is going to capitulate, you have to either earn an Initiative point to remove this rule, or alternatively you could go for Realpolitic and make your own faction. Remember to add the rule the allows hosting exiled governments.  Make your way to Realpolitic and create a "Bastion of Liberty" faction. Use your first initiative point to allow your faction to host governments in exile. Guarantee Finland. Wait for the winter war to start and accept the call to arms. Improve relations and send an attache to Finland. You should have enough relations to invite them to your faction despite the distance. Its important to invite them quickly, as they will white peace the Soviets if they arent in a faction. Once they capitulate you will get the achievement.
mi_casa_es_tu_casa.notes_ja: 直訳すると「私の家はあなたの家」、気軽にくつろいでくださいというスペイン語のフレーズ。
mi_casa_es_tu_casa.tsv_name: Mi Casa es tu Casa（くつろいでって！） As Mexico, host a government-in-exile.

the_new_home_of_the_revolution.requirements_en: Lev Trotsky is the current country leader   The  Soviet Union is a subject of  Mexico
the_new_home_of_the_revolution.requirements_ja: メキシコで、トロツキーを国家指導者とし、ソビエト連邦を傀儡にする。【要MtG】
the_new_home_of_the_revolution.notes_en: Choose to invite Trotsky in the "Trotsky seeks refuge" event. Follow the rightmost side of the focus tree to become communist and put Trotsky in charge. Join  Germanys war against the  Soviet Union via the Smash the Bureaucrats focus. To gain warscore, ask Germany for military access and put your troops on their front line. Alternatively, try to naval invade Soviet's far east front and capture a few victory point provinces. During the peace conference, puppet the Soviet Union.
the_new_home_of_the_revolution.tsv_name: The New Home of the Revolution（革命の新居） As Mexico, put Trotsky in power and puppet the Soviet Union

Increase your power as much as possible, by focusing on army, industry and by taking out  Hungary and  Bulgaria. Join the Axis, but never join any of their wars. When they are defeated, you will become the leader, earning you the achievement.

Make sure to also build as many naval dockyards as possible. Take focuses that help with research, construction speed and dockyard output. Assign all available dockyards to producing destroyers.

ジューヌ・エコールは、19世紀フランス海軍で提唱された戦略構想。
大艦巨砲主義の対極に位置し、小型艦艇で戦艦に対抗するというもの。なお結果は
vive_la_jeune_ecole.tsv_name: Vive la Jeune Ecole（ジューヌ・エコール万歳） As France, have at least 150 Destroyers and research the maximum torpedo launcher technology, before 1945.

30_minutes_of_hel.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see 30 Minutes of Hel

pride_and_extreme_prejudice.requirements_en: Sank the British Pride of the Fleet
pride_and_extreme_prejudice.requirements_ja: イギリス以外の国家で、イギリスの海軍の誇りを撃沈する。【要MtG】
pride_and_extreme_prejudice.notes_en: It can be done quickly as  Japan. The Japanese fleet is immediately capable of sinking not just the HMS Hood, but the entire Royal Navy if played properly. Choose Purge the Kodoha Faction and justify on the  UK (or  British Malaya) as soon as possible. Ask  Germany for docking rights, and move your entire fleet to their port nearest to the UK. Use the bulk of your fleet as a strike force, with three groups of destroyers patrolling the naval areas around the UK. If possible, you can also use naval bombers as well for added firepower. When the justification has finished, declare war on them. If Germany invites you to the Axis you should accept in order to use their airfields. From there just keep beating the Brits and building new ships and bombers (importing Oil for fuel if needed) until your fleet sinks the Hood and unlocks the achievement.
pride_and_extreme_prejudice.notes_ja:
『高慢と偏見（Pride and Prejudice）』はイギリスの長編小説。
"Extreme Prejudice"の元になった"Terminate with extreme prejudice"は米陸軍特殊部隊の隠語。司法用語の「（懲戒解雇ではない、会社都合の）予断なき解雇（Terminate without prejudice）」の逆で「極めて予断に満ちた解雇」、すなわち「お前が悪いから処刑する」という意味。ベトナム戦争中にとあるベトナム人協力者の二重スパイが発覚した際、裁判はおろか軍法会議でも死刑にできないため、この言葉による指令で暗殺処分が下された。この組織的な私刑殺人が戦後に「グリーンベレー事件」として問題化して隠語も公となり、映画『地獄の黙示録』で使われて有名になった。
両者を合わせた"Pride and Extreme Prejudice"は、イギリスで放映されたテレビ映画のタイトル。フレデリック・フォーサイス原作のスパイ・スリラー。
pride_and_extreme_prejudice.tsv_name: Pride and Extreme Prejudice（高慢と偏見） Sink the British Pride of the Fleet.

do_you_mined.requirements_en: Any country at war with player has more than 999 mines on their coastline
do_you_mined.requirements_ja: いずれかの国で、敵国の沿岸に999個の機雷を敷設する。【要MtG】
do_you_mined.notes_en: As  Italy, remove your divisions from Eritrea (550) or Somaliland (559)(keeping your ports for maximum efficiency). Lay mines on the Ethiopian shore with your starting navy until you reach 1000 mines. However, if you lose all your territory you will white peace with  Ethiopia.

i_didnt_vote_for_you.requirements_en: Is  Regional Defense Council of Aragón   No other country with the original tag of  Spain exists
i_didnt_vote_for_you.requirements_ja: 無政府主義者でスペイン内戦に勝利する。
i_didnt_vote_for_you.notes_en: Anarchist Spain is created from either Masters of Our Own Fate focus or the Government Crackdown event.  At the start of the game focus on building military factories in Valencia. As long as you control Valencia when the Anarchist uprising fires, you will be given control of it. Easier if the  Nationalists are weakened by the  Carlist rebellion. This can be done by keeping control of the northern states (Asturias & Pais Vasco) for as long as possible. On non-historical, they may also simply not take the focuses in the right order to prevent the uprising from happening.
i_didnt_vote_for_you.notes_ja:

our_chief_weapon_is_surprise.notes_ja: こちらもモンティ・パイソンのスケッチ「スペイン宗教裁判」が元ネタ。「our chief weapon is surprise...（我らの武器は唐突）」から言い直すたびに武器が増えていき、最終的に「恐怖、唐突、脅迫、教皇への狂信、赤い服」の5つになる。
our_chief_weapon_is_surprise.tsv_name: Our Chief Weapon is Surprise...（我らの武器は、突然の登場！） As Spain, have at least 5 spies and stage 5 coups against other nations.

die_albion.requirements_en: Ruling party is Fascist   Controls all European cores of the  United Kingdom and  Ireland
die_albion.requirements_ja:
ファシスト・フランスかヴィシーフランスで、イギリス全土を占領する。
二度目の正直 (Second Time’s the Charm)
フランスで、ナポレオン6世が国家元首のときにモスクワを占領する。
die_albion.notes_en: Rush the fascist focuses. Upon taking Utilize the Leagues, you will have access to decisions of boosting fascist and non-aligned popularity. Hire the fascist demagogue and spam "Rally the Leagues" decision; never take "Unleash La Cagoule" decision. Once you have 50% of fascist and non-aligned combined popularity, you can continue working on the fascist focuses. Take the Political Unity focus as soon as possible, as it removes the chance of spawning the civil war. After that rush towards Expand to the Suez focus. Immediately declare war on Britain and annex them. Your starting army is strong enough to easily destroy Britain.
die_albion.notes_ja:
パーフィディアスはラテン語で不信仰・不誠実の意。アルビオンはイギリスの古称。
三枚舌外交に対する批判の意を込めた、イギリスへの軽蔑的な呼称である。
現代日本語的に言うと「このブリカスめ！」といった感じだろうか。
海外版「三度目の正直」を意味する"third time's the charm"の捩り。1812年ロシア戦役でナポレオンらがモスクワに侵攻し、敗北、退却したのが元ネタか。
die_albion.tsv_name: Die, Perfidious Albion!（パーフィディアス・アルビオン） As Fascist France or Vichy France, occupy all of Great Britain.

second_times_charm.requirements_en: Controls Moscow (219)   Napoléon VI is the current country leader
second_times_charm.notes_en: Rush towards Proclaim the Third Empire focus to get Napoléon VI. Wait until Germany declares war on  Poland and then declare war on the  United Kingdom. Accept the invitation to join  Germany's faction. Your starting army and fleet will be enough to destroy the  United Kingdom. Annex them in the peace conference. Guarantee  Finland when the  USSR starts justifying a war goal on them. Accept the call to arms and invite the rest of the Axis. This will make the war easier as the  Soviet Union will not receive the "Great Patriotic War" buff. Earn enough warscore and ask your allies for control of Moscow (219).
second_times_charm.tsv_name: Second Time’s the Charm As France, occupy Moscow while Napoleon VI is your country leader.

you_will_never_kill_me_alive.notes_en: Build an intelligence agency and make sure to get the Suicide Pills upgrade. Keep sending your operatives on missions, or just have them perform various activities like 'Build Intel Network' in other countries (preferably the  Soviet Union). Eventually one of them will die and the achievement will trigger.
you_will_never_kill_me_alive.notes_ja:

you_will_never_kill_me_alive.tsv_name: You Will Never Kill Me Alive（殺されるもんですか） Have one of your spies take a Suicide Pill.

istanbul_is_constantinople_again.requirements_en: Owns Istanbul (797)   Istanbul has been renamed to Constantinople
istanbul_is_constantinople_again.requirements_ja:
ギリシャで、イスタンブールを獲得しコンスタンティノープルに改名する。
ペータルの誇り (Peter’s Pride)
ペータル2世のユーゴスラビアで、叔父を追放して国王になる。
istanbul_is_constantinople_again.notes_en: The  Greek focuses resulting from Resurrecting the Megali Idea allow for a war with  Turkey where you will gain Istanbul (797). Simply invite the  UK,  France, and  Italy, and promise them all concessions. Some of them will join the war and grant you the needed land.   Note: Even if the  United Kingdom or  France has agreed to split up  Turkey, they can individually bail on the war when you declare war. The achievement is earned by taking 3 decisions: Restore Byzantium, Revive Byzantium and Form Greater Greece. Note 2: At least as of 1.16, neither France nor the UK will even attend the conference unless they have over 20% war support, so, if you rush the "Megali Idea" focus and trigger the event too early, the conference will simply not happen. And if you choose to cooperate with fascists when you get the "Negotiations with the EEE" event, that also makes their participation unlikely. You'll be able to bypass the focus and move on to Horror and Fear, which lets you declare war on Turkey alone. It will be tricky work, since Turkey will likely have a larger standing army than you, and especially because Turkey will be guaranteed by Romania at that point, but it can be done. (It has to be done relatively quickly, though: if the conference fails, the UK tends to guarantee Turkey by March 1939, and Romania will join the Axis in mid-1940 if you're lucky, the Allies in September 1939 if you're not.) When going down this route, it helps to puppet Bulgaria before attempting Turkey.
istanbul_is_constantinople_again.notes_ja:
50年代アメリカのノベルティソング「Istanbul (Not Constantinople)」が元ネタ。ロックバンドThey Might Be Giantsのカバーは日本でも有名か。
歌い出しの特徴的な「Istanbul was Constantinople...」というフレーズは、Youtubeなど現代のネット文化でも流行した。
おじとは初期元首の摂政のパヴレのこと。
元ネタは聖書。「ペテロ（英語読みピーター、スラブ語読みペータル）」がイエス・キリストの十二使徒の筆頭格であることは言わずもがな。
「ペテロ」とはもともとイエスの付けた渾名であり、ヘブライ語で「岩」、つまり頑固者という意味。ペテロの自信に満ちた誇り高き（プライドが高い）人格を物語っている。
istanbul_is_constantinople_again.tsv_name: Istanbul is Constantinople. Again.（イスタンブール・イズ・コンスタンティノープル） As Greece, capture Istanbul and rename it to Constantinople.

peters_pride.notes_en: Simply go down and complete a focus which puts Peter in charge, such as End the Regency. With historical AI, you won't be attacked before you can take the focus.
peters_pride.tsv_name: Peter’s Pride As Peter II of Yugoslavia, overthrow your uncle and become King.

this_is_madness.requirements_ja: ギリシャで、メガリ・イデアを実現し大ギリシャを建国する。
this_is_madness.notes_en: The Megali Idea involves you,  UK, and  France agreeing to attack and split up  Turkey so you are guaranteed the land required in the peace deal. Do note that the UK and France can individually bail on the war when you complete the focus to attack Turkey even if they agreed at the convention, but it is still easy to beat Turkey with just one of them and is possible to beat them by yourself. (See also notes for "Istanbul is Constantinople. Again.")  The decision to form  Greater Greece is unlocked either by the focus Nenikikamen while your leader is not Georgios Kosmidis, by completing the focus The Modern Movement and choosing to have Ioannis Metaxas as your country leader, or by completing the focus Prepare for the Great Anti-Fascist War.
this_is_madness.notes_ja:
映画『300 〈スリーハンドレッド〉』で降伏を拒否したスパルタのレオニダスに対するペルシア使者のセリフ。この直後「This is Sparta!(これがスパルタだ！)」のセリフと共にレオニダスに蹴り落される。
本作の印象的なシーンではあるが海外では「This is Sparta!」は印象的を通り越してネットミームと化している。
実績のマークも『300』でレオニダスを演じるジェラルド・バトラーの顔が使われている。(肖像権は問題無いのだろうか?)
this_is_madness.tsv_name: This is Madness!（これは狂気だ！） As Greece, fulfil the Megali Idea and then form Greater Greece.

nobodys_business_but_the_turks.notes_ja:

kurdish_achievement.requirements_ja: クルディスタンで、すべての中核州を支配する。
kurdish_achievement.notes_en: Note:  Kurdistan cannot be released by  Turkey,  Syria,  Iran and  Iraq if Battle for the Bosporus is enabled. This achievement is now possible (patch 1.16.5) through the Iraq focus tree with Graveyard of Empires enabled if you go down the Promote Kurdish Identity path.  As of 1.16.9, likely due to a bug, this achievement calls for the control of Malatya (344), which is only a claim, but not for Mosul (676), which is one of Kurdistan's cores. As such, if you seize all the required states and attempt to release Kurdistan, the achievement won't fire. You'll have to go to war with Turkey and seize control of Malatya to get the achievement.   For detailed strategies, see House of Kurds
kurdish_achievement.notes_ja:
エジプト以来の構成国/植民地の実績。
国家を持たないクルド人問題は、元を辿るとセーヴル条約でのクルディスタン建国が、列強各国によって反故にされた事まで遡る。
現実にも同名の組織がある。
kurdish_achievement.tsv_name: House of Kurds（クルド人の家） As Kurdistan, hold all of your cores.

greek_civility.requirements_en: Has won the Greek Civil War before January 1st, 1937
greek_civility.requirements_ja: 1937年までにギリシャ内戦に勝利する。
greek_civility.notes_en: Before the civil war fires delete all land units and make a single cavalry division in training. Deploy it in Athens after the war starts and take all victory points to quickly end the civil war. Naval invade Crete (182) if necessary.  With Battle for the Bosporus, civil war can be triggered by not arresting the King and going down the The Right to Rule path. Without Battle for the Bosporus, you have to manually trigger a civil war using party popularity mechanics.  Since you have a timer for when the civil war starts, you can time the "Reorganize the Royal Guard" focus to complete one day after the civil war starts. If you have deleted all units previously, the two units granted by the focus will be enough to immideately win the war.
greek_civility.notes_ja:
ヘレネスとはギリシャ人の自称で、ギリシャ（英通称：Greece）も公式名称は「Hellenic Republic」である。
古代ギリシャ人は自らをヘレネス（英雄ヘレンの子）と称し、異民族であるバルバロイ（蛮人）と区別した一方で、都市国家間（つまりヘレネス同士）の戦争も絶えなかった。
この「誇り高い民族意識」と「民族内部の対立意識」の矛盾・混沌こそがヘレネスの流儀、秩序なのである。
なお史実では1946年から1949年に右派政府と共産系パルチザンが内戦をしていた。
greek_civility.tsv_name: Hellenic Civility（ヘレネス流の礼儀） Win the Greek Civil War before 1937.

hoofin_it.requirements_ja:
ラクダ騎兵30個師団を持った状態でアラビアを統一する。
俺たちはバンドを再結成するんだ (We’re Putting the Band Back Together)
トルコで、ドイツ・オーストリア＝ハンガリーと同じ陣営に加盟する。
hoofin_it.notes_en: You can do this as any nation, as long as you have camel units.  Easiest as the  United Kingdom since it already controls all the territory needed, except  Saudi Arabia,  Oman and  Yemen. Take The King's Party focus route, justify and annex the 3 independent nations of the peninsula. Make a camel template and train 30 of them. You start the game with camels unlocked, but you have to make the template yourself. NOTE: Territory needs to be owned directly (not through puppets and not merely occupied), you'll need to reduce autonomy and annex Oman (which is easy), and, if the British Raj failed to hand over Aden back in 1936, you'll have to annex the Raj too (which is trickier, since The King's Party sets it on the path for independence and gives it a large daily autonomy boost).   Countries with Camelry battalions:   Ethiopia: Unlocks with Animal Husbandry (By Blood Alone required)   Turkey: Unlocks with Desert Camel Corps and The Tuz Gölü Training Facility (Battle for the Bosporus required)   Sultanate of Aussa: At the game start  At the game start with Battle for the Bosporus enabled:    British Raj   France   Iraq   Italy *   Oman   United Kingdom   Saudi Arabia   Spain   Yemen
hoofin_it.notes_ja:
「Hoofing(it)」は「歩いていく、踊る」などを意味するイディオム。「hoof」の原義はらくだや馬の蹄のこと。
映画「The Blues Brothers」のセリフ。ネットミームになっている。
なお実績の画像がトルコの「アブデュルメジト2世」、オーストリア＝ハンガリーの「オットー・フォン・ハプスブルク」、ドイツの「ヴィルヘルム3世」となっている。(あれヴィルヘルム2世さん…?)

were_putting_the_band_back_together.tsv_name: We’re Putting the Band Back Together As Turkey, be in a faction with Germany and Austria-Hungary.

draculas_revenge.requirements_ja: ユーゴスラビアで、トランシルバニアに自治州を作り、ルーマニアの中核州すべてを持たせる。
draculas_revenge.notes_en: Before 1.12 / By Blood Alone: Go down the communist focus tree towards Pan-Balkan Initiative and instigate an uprising in  Romania. When the communists win the civil war, justify on them and declare war (they will not be guaranteed by anyone). Puppet  Transylvania in the peace conference and give them all Romanian territory. Starting with 1.12, this doesn't work because of the rework of the peace conference system. You have two choices. Either go down Western focus branch, release Transylvania as a puppet using Autonomy for Slavic Transylvania, and then defeat Romania; or go Communist and defeat Romania twice (first to create the Transylvania puppet, then to give them the rest of Romanian cores). The second route is extra-hard (on historical, anyway), because you need to do it all before the Soviet Union demands Bessarabia in mid-1940.
draculas_revenge.notes_ja:
EU4にも同名の実績が存在する。
同名のボードゲームもあるので、それが元ネタか？（パラドのルーツはボードゲーム会社）
draculas_revenge.tsv_name: 【ドラキュラの復讐】 Dracula’s Revenge As Yugoslavia, establish the autonomous region of Transylvania and have it own all Romanian cores.

prussia_of_the_balkans.requirements_en: Is at war with  Turkey    Turkey has capitulated   Controls all cores of  Romania,  Yugoslavia,  Greece (except Dodecaneso (164)), and  Albania
prussia_of_the_balkans.requirements_ja: ブルガリアで、トルコを降伏させ、ギリシャ含むバルカン半島の残りすべてを支配する。
prussia_of_the_balkans.notes_en: You only need to occupy the states, not own them. Switch to communist and get as many Balkan countries as possible in your faction. The country will flip above 60% communist support ( Romania and  Greece are particularly important to get on your side). Any Balkan country in your faction can be annexed through the The Unification of the Balkans focus. Once you have established the Federation, attack whoever still controls land in the Balkans and capitulate  Turkey.   Note:  Turkey needs to be in a faction when they capitulate to satisfy the "at war" and "has capitulated" requirements. Otherwise when they capitulate, they are no longer at war and the achievement doesn't fire.
prussia_of_the_balkans.notes_ja: 第一次バルカン戦争前後のブルガリアは精強な軍事大国であり、他国からは「バルカンのプロイセン」と呼ばれ、ブルガリアもそれを自称していた。
prussia_of_the_balkans.tsv_name: Prussia of the Balkans（バルカンのプロイセン） As Bulgaria capitulate Turkey while also controlling the rest of the Balkans, including Greece.

balkan_problem_solved.requirements_en: Ruling party is Communist   Is faction leader   Has completed focus The Unification of the Balkans   Controls all your core states
balkan_problem_solved.requirements_ja: コミュニスト・ブルガリアで、United Balkan Federation(統一バルカン連邦)を建国し、バルカン半島の州をすべて中核州として支配する。
balkan_problem_solved.notes_en: Note: You don't need to own all core states of  Romania,  Greece,  Yugoslavia and  Albania, but you do need to control all core states of  Bulgaria. Ensure you also control Dodecaneso (164).   For detailed strategies, see Balkan Problem Solved
balkan_problem_solved.notes_ja: これぞソビエト的解決法
balkan_problem_solved.tsv_name: Balkan Problem Solved（バルカン問題の解決） As Communist Bulgaria, form the United Balkan Federation and own all Balkan states as cores.

bad_romeance.requirements_en: Byzantine Empire has  Soviet Union,  Romania and  Italy as subjects.
bad_romeance.requirements_ja: ビザンツ帝国を復興し、イタリア、ルーマニア、ロシアを従属国とする。
bad_romeance.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see Bad Romeance
bad_romeance.notes_ja:
元ネタはレディー・ガガの楽曲「Bad Romance」。実績画像も彼女の画像が使われている。
Romance（ロマンス）とRome（ローマ）をかけた駄洒落になっている。
bad_romeance.tsv_name: Bad Romeance（バッド ローマンス） Restore Byzantium and have Italy, Romania, and Russia as subjects.

totally_not_cool_bromania.requirements_en: Romania has switched sides and capitulated a former ally (which had not capitulated at the time of the switch)
totally_not_cool_bromania.requirements_ja: ルーマニアで、戦争中に相手方に寝返り、以前の同盟国を降伏させる。
totally_not_cool_bromania.notes_en: Take the focus Revise the Constitution then take Balkans Dominance. Build an army to at least 500k manpower and take the Align Hungary and Split Czechoslovakia focuses. If  Hungary refuses, win the war and puppet them.  Germany should also agree to split  Czechoslovakia giving  Romania a  Slovakian puppet. Take the Appoint Pro-Axis Government, take the Fascist Demagogue and flip to fascism. Then head to Force Abdication. Remove the Fascist Demagogue once Romania flips to fascism. Wait until Germany declares war against  Poland and  Bulgaria joins the Axis. Join the war but do not let Hungary and Slovakia into the war. Place the army on the Bulgarian Border. Take King Michael's Coup to flip to democratic and wait until Poland capitulates and the  Soviet Union takes Eastern Poland. Take the "Join the Allies" decision and capitulate Bulgaria.
totally_not_cool_bromania.notes_ja:
「Totally Cool」で「全然構わないよ」というイディオムなので、Notでその逆となる。後半はBro.（兄弟）とRomaniaをかけていると思われる。
昨日の兄弟は今日の敵、ルーマニアに裏切られても全然構わないと強がる枢軸国だが、どう考えても致命傷である。
totally_not_cool_bromania.tsv_name: Totally Not Cool, Bromania（全然構わなくないよ、兄弟。） As Romania, change sides in the war and capitulate a former ally.

freedom_or_death.requirements_en: Is at war with  Italy   Has full control of Northern Epirus (805), Central Albania (44), and Shkodër (934)
freedom_or_death.requirements_ja: ギリシャで、イタリアと戦争中にアルバニアを解放する。
freedom_or_death.notes_en: Go fascist and justify on  Albania once you flip. Since  Italy is guaranteeing Albania they will join  Albania once you declare war on them. Make sure to rush for the port so that the  Italians cannot bring over their troops. Capitulate  Albania and take all their land.
freedom_or_death.tsv_name: Freedom or Death（自由か死か） As Greece, liberate Albania while being at war with Italy.

now_this_is_getting_childish.requirements_en: Bulgaria is at war with  Yugoslavia    Bulgaria: Regency Council is the current country leader    Yugoslavia: country leader has the Underage Monarch trait
now_this_is_getting_childish.requirements_ja:
ユーゴスラビアかブルガリアで、プレイ中に両国が子供に統治されている間に戦争状態になる。
まるで意味のないセーヴル条約 (Hardly Anything Sèvres)
オスマン帝国で、フランス・イギリス・イタリア・日本の首都を獲得する。
アタテュルクの下の分割すべからざる一国家 (One Nation Under Atatürk, Indivisible)
中道主義トルコで、ネガティブな州補正をゼロにする。
now_this_is_getting_childish.notes_en: The Regency Council is formed through Form a Regency Council focus. Go for Plot Against Boris focus and pick the decisions to kill him, then choose a pro-Axis regent and join the Axis. Going down "The democratic principle" seems easier than "The Tsars regime". Prince Paul will be replaced by Peter II in February 1941, and  Germany will attack Yugoslavia soon after. Join the war to get the achievement.  Not clear how (or if!) this is doable as Yugoslavia: the problem is that the only possible Yugoslavian underage monarch, Peter II, loses his 'underage monarch' trait in September 1941 when he turns 18, but Tsar Boris III of Bulgaria only dies in 1943 under historical AI, and you have no way to influence that.
now_this_is_getting_childish.notes_ja:
ユーゴスラビアはペータル2世(子供の姿)、ブルガリアはシメオン2世(摂政評議会の姿)である。
セーヴル条約とは、WW1で敗戦したオスマンが、戦勝国である連合国と結んだ条約。シリアやエジプトなど多くの領土を割譲することになった。
言わずもがな英仏伊日はWW1の戦勝国であり、それらを占領してしまえばセーヴル条約はまるっきし意味を為さなくなるのである。
元ネタはアメリカ合衆国の「忠誠の誓い」。アメリカの学校や公式行事でしばしば暗唱される。日本でいうところの「君が代」に近い。
「I pledge allegiance to the Flag of the USA,（中略）, one Nation under God, indivisible, with liberty and justice for all.（私はアメリカ合衆国国旗と（中略）神の下の分割すべからざる一国家に、忠誠を誓います。）」
now_this_is_getting_childish.tsv_name: Now This is Getting Childish（いよいよ子供っぽくなってきた） As Yugoslavia or Bulgaria, be at war while both countries are ruled by a child.

hardly_anything_sevres.requirements_en: One of the following must be true:    Has cosmetic tag  Ottoman Sultanate (or ideology variants)   Has cosmetic tag  Ottoman Empire (or ideology variants)   Controls Ile de France (16), Greater London Area (126), Lazio (2), and Kanto (282)
hardly_anything_sevres.requirements_ja: オットー・フォン・ハプスブルク率いるオーストリアまたはハンガリーで、オーストリア、ハンガリー、チェコスロヴァキア、ルーマニア、ブルガリア、ギリシャ、トルコの初期領土と、ポーランド領ガリツィア、スロベニア、クロアチアの全州を支配する。
hardly_anything_sevres.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see Hardly Anything Sèvres
hardly_anything_sevres.notes_ja: オットー(Otto)とオスマンの英語読みであるオットマン(Ottoman)を掛けたギャグ。
hardly_anything_sevres.tsv_name: 【オットー・マン】 Hardly Anything Sèvres As the Ottoman Empire, hold the capitals of France, the United Kingdom, Italy, and Japan.

one_nation_under_ataturk_indivisible.play_as: Turkey   Battle for the Bosporus is enabled
one_nation_under_ataturk_indivisible.requirements_en: Ruling party is Non-Aligned   Has any negative state modifiers:  Kurdish Agitation   Kurdish Separatism   Kurdish Rebellion   Traditionalist Opposition   Traditionalist Sedition   Traditionalist Insurgency   Kemalist Schemers
one_nation_under_ataturk_indivisible.notes_en: Go the Kemalist route through the Continue the Policy of Etatism and Peace at Home focuses. Take the Silent Workhorse advisor and use the Secularism decision whenever available to block the expansion of your Islamist rivals. Türk Ulusu focus will pacify the Kurdish states, while the Islamist opposition can be dealt with through the Counter-Fundamentalist Operation or compromise decisions (as long as the Kemalist remain loyal). You do not have to go to war and simply need enough political power to repeat the decisions. The achievement will trigger when all Islamic states are Placated, and the Kurdish states are either at Separatist Fatigue or cored.
one_nation_under_ataturk_indivisible.tsv_name: One Nation Under Atatürk, Indivisible As non-aligned Turkey, have zero negative state modifiers.

master_puppeteer.requirements_en: Has completed focus The Fate of the Balkans   At least 6 of the following is a subject of  Bulgaria:      Romania   Yugoslavia   Hungary   Greece   Albania   Serbia   Turkey   Slovenia   Bosnia   Herzegovina   Macedonia   Independent State of Croatia   Kosovo   Republic of Montenegro
master_puppeteer.requirements_ja: ブルガリアで、バルカン半島に5つ以上の傀儡国がある状態で国家方針「The Fate of the Balkans」を完了する。
master_puppeteer.notes_en: After completing The Fate of the Balkans you get the ability to peacefully puppet any nation with a Balkan capital who is in your faction, as well as the capacity to force them into your faction if they are not already in one. A puppeted  Yugoslavia can be integrated with its constituent states released as puppets for this achievement, or you can seize 803 (106) from them via decision. These states can make the puppets  Macedonia and  Serbia. In order to get states to join your faction via decision it is important to have more manpower deployed to the field, and puppet expeditionary forces contribute to this number.
master_puppeteer.notes_ja:
ブルガリアをはじめとした東欧では人形劇が盛んで、国立の人形劇場や劇団が存在するなど、伝統芸能となっている。
経済的な差もあり、日本ではチェコのマリオネットの方が有名かもしれないが、それでもブルガリアは世界的な人形劇作家や劇団を多く輩出している。
master_puppeteer.tsv_name: Master Puppeteer（人形劇の天才） As Bulgaria, complete the focus The Fate of the Balkans while having 5 or more Balkan puppets.

at_least_they_run_on_time.requirements_en: Has railway of level 5 in:   Sardegna (114)  Piemonte (158)  Lombardia (159)  Alto Adige (39)  Trentino (850)  Veneto (160)  Litorale (736)  Istria (852)  Emilia Romagna (161)  Abruzzo (157)  Toscana (162)  Lazio (2)  Campania (117)  Calabria (156)  Puglia (849)  Sicilia (115)
at_least_they_run_on_time.requirements_ja: イタリアで、ファシスト政権のままで、イタリアのすべての中核州に最大レベルの鉄道を敷く。
at_least_they_run_on_time.notes_en: Only a single province per state needs a level 5 railway. By making the connecting level 5 rail run through two states it counts for both.
at_least_they_run_on_time.notes_ja:
元ネタは古いことわざの「Mussolini made the trains run on time(ムッソリーニは電車を時間通りに走らせた)」から来ている。
「業績はともかく、"少なくとも彼はイタリアの鉄道を時刻通りに走らせた"」という意味。
at_least_they_run_on_time.tsv_name: At least they run on time!（定刻通りに走る列車だ！） As fascist Italy, have max level railways in all your core states

not_much_fun_in_stalingrad.requirements_en: Capitulated the  Soviet Union without taking the city of Stalingrad or having troops in any province in its state
not_much_fun_in_stalingrad.requirements_ja: ドイツで、スターリングラードを占領せずにソビエト連邦を降伏させる。
not_much_fun_in_stalingrad.notes_en: It is recommended to use spies to create a Collaboration Government  and lower the stability of the  Soviet Union to decrease their surrender threshold. Most easily done with historical focuses on, immediately justifying on Poland then once the war concludes justifying on the Soviets.
not_much_fun_in_stalingrad.notes_ja:
モンティ・パイソンのネタ「ヒトラーのいる民宿」元ネタで、実績画像もその一コマが採用されている。
訳文もそこから引用しています。
not_much_fun_in_stalingrad.tsv_name: Not much fun in Stalingrad（スターリングラードでお楽しみなんて…無理でしょ？） As Germany, capitulate the Soviet Union without taking Stalingrad.

no_more_partitions.requirements_en: Germany either:  Does not exist   Is in Faction with  Poland    Soviet Union either:  Does not exist   Is in Faction with  Poland    Is fully independent.   Controls all your core states
no_more_partitions.requirements_ja: ポーランドで、独立したまま、かつ、ドイツとソ連両国が自国の陣営に入るか存在しないようにする。
no_more_partitions.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see No more Partitions
no_more_partitions.notes_ja:
なぜ独ソのために分割さればならないのだ?
ポーランドが全ての中核州を支配してないと実績が解除されないので注意
no_more_partitions.tsv_name: No more Partitions（分割は無しだ） As Poland, be independent and ensure that both Germany and the USSR are either in your faction or don’t exist.

habsburgs_habsburgs_everywhere.requirements_en: Karl Albrecht I is the current country leader    Hungary has Otto von Habsburg as the current country leader   Is in Faction with  Hungary
habsburgs_habsburgs_everywhere.requirements_ja: ポーランドで、ハプスブルク家を戴き、他のハプスブルク家国家と同盟する。
habsburgs_habsburgs_everywhere.notes_en: Karl Albrecht I can be elected king after choosing Assemble the Regency Council and then Fulfil the 5th of November Act. The Soldier King, The King's Guard and Press the Habsburg Claim will put Otto von Habsburg on the Hungarian throne, and completing A Habsburg Alliance will create the Habsburg faction.
habsburgs_habsburgs_everywhere.notes_ja: つまりオーストリア=ハンガリーである。
habsburgs_habsburgs_everywhere.tsv_name: Habsburgs. Habsburgs everywhere（どこもかしこもハプスブルク） As Poland, install a Habsburg monarch and be in a faction with another Habsburg monarch.

the_pope_how_many_divisions_does_he_have.requirements_ja: ソビエト連邦で、ローマを占領する。
the_pope_how_many_divisions_does_he_have.notes_en: Can be done relatively easily by defeating the Axis together with the Allies and simply taking Lazio (2) in the peace deal.
the_pope_how_many_divisions_does_he_have.notes_ja:
スタートアップ格言にも存在するスターリンの発言、テヘラン会談でローマ教皇の影響力を語るチャーチルにこう返したとされているが、実際には言ってない説もある。
なお格言の方は「The Pope! How many divisions has he got?」である。
the_pope_how_many_divisions_does_he_have.tsv_name: The Pope? How many Divisions does he have?（ローマ教皇？　いったい彼は何個師団を有しているのかね？） As the USSR take Rome.

this_is_going_to_be_lit.requirements_ja: リトアニアで、リトアニアに隣接する国すべての首都を占領する。
this_is_going_to_be_lit.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see This is going to be LIT
this_is_going_to_be_lit.notes_ja:
LITは「ヤバい(いい意味で)」や「よかった」を意味するスラングであり、HoI4内部データにおいてリトアニアを意味する国家タグでもある。
つまりThis is going to be lit（イケてる）で「いい感じになるぜ！」的な文章とThis is going to be Lithuania（リトアニア）で「ここもリトアニアになるんだよ！」的な文章のダブルミーニングということ。
this_is_going_to_be_lit.tsv_name: This is going to be LIT（ここはイケてるリトアニア） As Lithuania, hold the capitals of all of your neighbours.
