it_has_my_name_on_it.requirements_ja: バルト諸国のいずれかで、バルト海の沿岸州をすべて征服する。
it_has_my_name_on_it.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see It has my name on it
it_has_my_name_on_it.notes_ja: 兄弟(姉妹)の冷蔵庫のプリンに名前が書いてあるように、バルト海沿岸の土地にも名前が書いてあるのだ（偽造文書である可能性は闇に葬る）
it_has_my_name_on_it.tsv_name: It has my name on it（私の名前が書いてありますよね） As any Baltic State, conquer the entire shoreline of the Baltic Sea.

this_achievement_is_cheesy.requirements_en: Controls Norrbotten (666)   Has completed focus Ostland
this_achievement_is_cheesy.requirements_ja: ラトビアで、オストラントを形成し、ヴェステルボッテンを征服する。
this_achievement_is_cheesy.notes_en: Note: The achievements description is misleading because it suggests Västerbotten (918) when in fact it requires Norrbotten (666).   For detailed strategies, see This Achievement is Cheesy
this_achievement_is_cheesy.notes_ja:
Cheesyにはスラングで「安っぽい」という意の他にそのまま「チーズ(正確なつづりはcheese)」という意を持つ。
そしてヴェステルボッテンは地名でもありチーズの名前でもある。
おそらくそこに掛けているのだろう(実績の画像もラトビアの旗が刺さったチーズである。)。
this_achievement_is_cheesy.tsv_name: This Achievement is Cheesy（チーズ味のある実績） As Latvia, form Ostland and occupy Vasterbotten.

esti_is_scandi.requirements_en: You or your puppet controls:   Oslofjord (110)  Vestlandet (142)  Trøndelag (143)  Nordland (144)  Norrbotten (666)  Gävleborg (38)  Södermanland (141)  Småland (139)  Västergötland (140)  Skåne (138)  Gotland (124)  Sjaelland (37)  Jylland (99)
esti_is_scandi.requirements_ja: エストニアで、スカンジナビアを確保する (追記：スカンジナビアのすべての国家は、エストニアまたはエストニアの属国に支配されている必要がある)
esti_is_scandi.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see Esti is Scandi
esti_is_scandi.notes_ja:
実績画像を見るに広義のスカンジナビア（フィンランドや大西洋の島も含む）と思われる。
元ネタはポーランドボール。エストニアボールは北欧扱いしてもらいたいのにしてもらえないキャラとして性格付けられている。
esti_is_scandi.tsv_name: Esti is Scandi（エストニアはスカンジナビア） As Estonia Secure Scandinavia.

not_a_step_back.requirements_en: After Jan 1st, 1945   Has lost a core state
not_a_step_back.requirements_ja: ソビエト連邦で、中核州の領域を一つたりとも占領されず1945年を迎える。
not_a_step_back.notes_en: Note: Do not take the focus "Reconcile Japan" since North Sakhalin is your core! Turn off historical German focuses, leaving everything else on historical. Alternatively, declare war on  Poland early, releasing  Belarus and  Ukraine as puppets while retaining your own cores and leave them outside of the war for an easier defensive line.
not_a_step_back.notes_ja:
占領されてはいけないのは中核州なので、旧ポーランド東部・バルト三国・ベッサラビアまでは占領されても問題ない。
DLCの名前と同じく「ソ連国防人民委員令第227号」が元ネタ。
not_a_step_back.tsv_name: Not a step back!（一歩も下がるな！） As the Soviet Union never lose 1 core territory to anyone before 1945.

one_step_forward.requirements_en: Is at war with  Poland   Is at war with  Germany   Germany attacked Poland first
one_step_forward.requirements_ja: ソビエト連邦で、ドイツがポーランドを攻撃する前にポーランドとドイツに宣戦布告をする。
one_step_forward.notes_en: Set up a frontline along the Polish border. Justify on Poland, then declare war. Justify and declare war on Germany too. You will get the achievement when you are at war with both Poland and Germany at the same time.
one_step_forward.notes_ja: 上と同じくNot a step backが元ネタで、下がる前に一歩踏み出せというネタ。
one_step_forward.tsv_name: One Step Forward（一歩前へ） As Soviet Union declare a war on Poland and Germany before Germany attacks Poland.

the_soviet_onion.requirements_en: Every neighbouring country is your subject
the_soviet_onion.requirements_ja: ソビエト連邦で、国境を傀儡国家としか隣接しないようにする。
the_soviet_onion.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see The Soviet Onion
the_soviet_onion.notes_ja:
Onion(玉ねぎ)と連邦を意味するUnion(ユニオン)をかけたネタ実績。
玉ねぎの皮のようにソビエトを傀儡で包み込もう。
なお、タマネギ「onion」の語源は、ラテン語の「union」から来ている模様。
the_soviet_onion.tsv_name: The Soviet Onion（ソビエト・オニオン） As the Soviet Union, have only puppets as neighbors.

the_romanovs_laugh_last.requirements_en: Either: Has national spirit  Tsar Vladimir I  Vladimir III Is the current country leader    You or your subjects control:    Brandenburg (64)  Bohemia (9)  Niederösterreich (4)  Northern Hungary (43)  Sofia (48)  Ankara (49)
the_romanovs_laugh_last.requirements_ja:
ソビエト連邦で、ロマノフ王朝を復活させ、ドイツ、ハンガリー、オーストリア、チェコスロヴァキア、トルコ、ブルガリアを征服する。
統計になるのは好きじゃない (We don’t really like statistics)
スターリンが元首のソビエト連邦で、合計100万人未満の死傷者を出している間にドイツを征服する。
the_romanovs_laugh_last.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see The Romanovs Laugh Last
the_romanovs_laugh_last.notes_ja:
メンツはWW1でロシア帝国が戦った中央同盟国の皆さん。
達成条件は各国の首都州を自国あるいは従属国が領有していることである。
つまり「1M」を迎える前にドイツを下さなければならない。
元ネタは条件にもあるスターリンの発言「一人の死は悲劇だが、百万の死は統計だ(The death of one man is a tragedy. The death of millions is a statistic.」で……はない「実は言ってない台詞」という奴。
これに関しては諸説あり、アイヒマン裁判で有名なナチス親衛隊員アドルフ・アイヒマンの発言とする説や、『西部戦線異状なし』の作者として有名なエーリヒ・マリア・レマルクであるとする説がある。
似た言葉にチャールズ・チャップリンの映画「殺人狂時代」に登場するセリフ「一人を殺せば殺人者だが、百万人を殺せば英雄だ(it's all business. One murder makes a villain; millions, a hero. Numbers sanctify)」も存在する。
そもそも「(少ない数字)はこうだけど、(大きい数字)はこう」といった内容は割と多く使われる。
the_romanovs_laugh_last.tsv_name: The Romanovs laugh last（最後に笑うのはロマノフ家） Restore the Romanovs to the throne and conquer Germany, Hungary, Austria, Czechoslovakia, Turkey, and Bulgaria.

race_for_germany.requirements_en: Conquered Germany after the Fall of France, before any other country took a core state of Germany.
race_for_germany.requirements_ja: ソビエト連邦で、フランスが降伏した後に連合国がドイツの中核州を一つでも占領する前にドイツを征服する。
race_for_germany.notes_en: When  Germany capitulates, all their core states have to fall under your control. France must be in the Allies and have capitulated.  The earlier the war, the better your odds. Go down the Collective Security branch and pick Eradicate Western Fascism (mid-1939 to optimize the attack bonus). Refuse the Molotov-Ribbentrop pact, and attack the German when they close in on Paris. Collaboration Government in Germany could be helpful.  Alternatively help Germany kill the Allies by naval invading the UK after the fall of France then kill Germany. It is safer but harder.
race_for_germany.notes_ja:
元ネタは世界ツーリングカーカップ(WTCR)の「Race of Germany」と思われる。

race_for_germany.tsv_name: Race for Germany（レース・フォー・ジャーマニー） As the Soviet union, capitulate Germany after the fall of France before the Allies control one German core state.

holy_roman_and_an_empire.requirements_en: The Pope has taken over  Italy     Italy has formed the  Roman Empire
holy_roman_and_an_empire.requirements_ja: 教皇としてローマを復興する。
holy_roman_and_an_empire.notes_en: For detailed strategies, see Holy, Roman, and an Empire
holy_roman_and_an_empire.notes_ja:
フランスの哲学者ヴォルテールの「神聖ローマ帝国、と自らを呼んだ、そしていまだに呼んでいるこの政体はいかなる点においても神聖ではなく、ローマ的でもなく、帝国でもなかった。」が元ネタ。
それを否定するように「神聖であり、ローマであり、帝国でもある」ことを宣言するのだ。
ただしこの言葉は「800年または962年~1806年」と君臨し続けた神聖ローマ帝国衰亡期の18世紀に語られた言葉であるため、単なる「詐称帝国」扱いするのは間違いである。
とはいえ初期から古代ローマ帝国の継承国の自認しながらローマらしい領土は持たず、帝国と言いながら寄り合い所帯のため強い権力を使えず、ローマ教皇との関係も後期では悪化していたため神聖ともいえない感じでもあったが…。
古代、中世、近代、現代、そして解釈者の住んでる風土で国、宗教に対する感じ方、扱い方が変わるため、神聖ローマ帝国の解釈は難しいのだ。
holy_roman_and_an_empire.tsv_name: Holy, Roman, and an Empire（神聖であり、ローマであり、帝国でもある） As the Pope, restore Rome.

だがここはアメリカのニューヨークではなくイタリア、「ピザ」ではなく「ピッツァ」である。忘れないように。

ｳｯｰｳｯｰｳﾏｳﾏ(ﾟ∀ﾟ)
スウェーデンで日本を傀儡国にする。
元ネタはスウェーデンの音楽グループ「キャラメル」の曲「Caramelldansen」。

antischluss.notes_en: Start by building max forts along the border with the Germans. Research AA after the basic industry and electronics research to build max AA in Tirol and Upper Austria after the forts. Build a spy agency and develop the diplomatic pressure upgrade. Take Repeal the May Constitution, Reichsbund der Österreicher, and Reinstate the Herrenhaus. Then work towards Devalue the Schilling. Take Architectural Advancements before continuing to Rebellious Rearmament. Once you have enough political power, hire Adolf Schärf, change mobilization law to partial mobilization, and hire Adolf Hoch. After taking Rebellious rearmament, train 18 of the standard infantry template.  Make sure to keep political power aside for the diplomatic annexation decisions. Put your spy on diplomatic pressure and pressure  Hungary, gaining an non-aggression pact while doing the "Demand Hungarian Submission Focus". Then do the same with  Poland. Take "Subjugate the Lands of Old" immediately after. Take the industrial bribery decision with  Hungary and then invite them to become an Austro-Hungarian Vassal. For  Czechoslovakia, rally against them and do border exercises, and send them the invite to become a subject.  Hungary and  Czechoslovakia usually accept at "Likely to accept" threshold. Move your spy from  Poland to  Yugoslavia then  Romania and offer non-aggression pacts to both. Improve relationships with the countries if need be. To maximise success with these three, take industrial bribery and joint military exercises before sending the invite to become a vassal. If time allows, do the same for Albania.  After "Subjugate the Lands of Old", work down to Österreichisches Bundesheer, and then down to "Improved Warfare Strategies" via the Franz Boehme Plan. Take the focuses "Bring Phönix Insurance From the Ashes" and "The Great Austrian Economic Push" as soon as the idea "Devalued the Schilling" expires. Then start the joint focus tree with "Indivisible and Inseperable".  Throughout this process, make sure to take the decisions to increase division defence on core territory for 25 political power and up security around military high command. Anschluss will happen soon. Try to get a non-aggression pact with  Italy as soon as  Germany declares war.  Once  Germany declares, focus on holding the forts, and feel free to call in  Romania,  Hungary,  Yugoslavia, and  Czechoslovakia but do not call in  Poland. Take "The Silesian Question" and work towards "The Better German State" via renewing claims in Italy. It is worth getting a non-aggression pact with the soviet union throughout this to prevent going to war with them at the same time as  Germany. Take the decision to integrate/core all German states over time.  While at war, try to encircle the tank divisions and fast moving divisions, this will help massively. If this is done, it becomes less risky to call in  Poland. Hold out until the allies join the war, at which point the axis can easily be defeated. By controlling as much German territory as possible during the war and integrating, they are cheaper to claim in the peace deal. If the axis is defeated before you can core all states, this should be ok as the German Republic should not be a puppet or subject of  France/ United Kingdom and not part of the allies. You will have much more manpower and can edit the infantry templates and add artillery and anti-air as necessary, as well as Austrian Italy potentially. The  Soviet Union will then declare war. Build sufficient mobilized infantry to encircle the soviet forces. Declare war on the German Republic (using "Annex Country" as cause if possible) and overrun them, they will be weakened. They may join  Japan at which point you will have to defeat Japan to end the war.  At some point, work towards the "Thousand Year Federation Focus" to make annexing vassals easier. They will never promote to puppet from Austro-Hungarian vassal so do not worry about that. Work towards building up your military and annexing the territories after the war with the USSR, and proclaiming the Austro-Hungarian Empire. Should you still not be able to take all German territory, build up and prepare to attack the allies via the "Wars against the Guarantors" Focus. France should be relatively easy to capitulate via Austrian Italy, and then the allied German puppets should be small enough to overrun. Make sure to have defences on the coast to prevent naval invasions.  Integrate all the Cores and the achievement should fire even if at war.

the_lenin_boys_are_back_in_town.notes_ja:
アイルランド出身のロック・バンド「シン・リジィ」が1976年に発表した楽曲「The Boys Are Back in Town(ヤツらは町へ)」と後述の「Lenin Boys」を掛けている。
Lenin-fiúk(Lenin Boys)とはハンガリー評議会共和国の準軍事組織。
1919年にハンガリー・ルーマニア戦争でルーマニア軍やホルティ提督の反共義勇軍に敗北し処刑された。

savior_of_the_holy_lands.notes_ja:
アイコンはゴーストバスターズのロゴ風にされたチンギス・ハン。
ハン（Khan）と"できない"を意味する「can't」を掛けている。
共産化せず、国民党ルートか対立ルートに進み国家方針が切り替わった後に、中華帝国ルートを進めば達成できる。
ドイツの作家ミヒャエル・エンデの作品『はてしない物語』、およびそれを映画にした『ネバーエンディングストーリー』から。
余談だが、作者のミヒャエルが、映画のラストに納得がいかず訴訟を起こし、最終的にスタッフロールから作者の名前を削除させた話は割と有名。
アイコンは登場キャラである「幸運の白い竜"ファルコン"」
ディズニーのアニメ映画『ラマになった王様』に出てくる憎めない悪役*4「クロンク」のセリフが元ネタ。
主人公を探す中で「主人公は農夫の馬車で逃げた」→「村を見つければ農夫も主人公もいるのでは!?」→「Oh Yeah, It's All Coming Together.（ああ、そうだ。全部うまくいきそうだ。）」の流れとなる。
アイコンはクロンクのドヤ顔を模した蔣介石。
1945年9月2日は、日本が降伏文書に署名した日。中華民国は翌9月3日を「対日戦争勝利記念日」としていた。これは中華人民共和国においても「抗日戦争勝利記念日」と称し、2015年に祝日と制定された。
「誰もいない OR 人目なし」を意味する言葉に海岸を意味する「Coast」が使われている理由は、海賊が蔓延っていた時代で接岸する際に敵の有無を確かめていたことから。
2009年に放送された『鋼の錬金術師 FULLMETAL ALCHEMIST』の英語名が"Fullmetal Alchemist Brotherhood"。これは2003年に放送された旧アニメ版の英語名"Fullmetal Alchemist"と区別するため。
Brotherhoodは「兄弟の絆」を意味する。
アイコンも『鋼の錬金術師』に出てくる錬金術版魔法陣の"錬成陣"に似ている。
開戦が40年までで、降伏させる時期は自由。
共産ルートに進み国家方針「新たな時代の門出」で労農派を勝たせ、NF「労農派の台頭」で荒畑寒村を指導者にする。
国家方針「無政府主義者との協力」で開放される政治顧問の「辻潤」
国家方針「仏教社会主義者の取り込み」で開放される政治顧問の「妹尾義郎*5」
2人を雇用した状態で国家方針「赤旗を高く掲げろ」のイベント「仏教社会主義の復興」で選択肢「これが我々の進み道だ！」を選択し指導者を「妹尾義郎」にする。
ここで解禁される隠し国家方針「一向一揆の精神を再生させる」と「浄仏国土の宣言」で実績達成。
『Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活』の後期オープニングテーマが元か
アイコンは法輪。
仏教の教えの数々がそれぞれ車輪を支える柱として存在し、車輪が回転するように人々を救い、また仏教が広まっていく様を例えた説法…が法輪の元となる話。
「浄仏国土」とは、穢れの無い仏や菩薩が住む清浄な国土を指す言葉。
おそらく経済学や建築業界の用語「等価交換」から。
とはいえDLC「NCNS」のノリを考えると『鋼の錬金術師』の方か？
なお錬金術に「等価交換」を用いるのは『鋼の錬金術師』のオリジナル要素とされる。
アイコンにもあるタコは風刺画で侵略する拡大国家としてよく使われ、日本も周囲を触手プレイで脅かす国として描かれた。
陸軍のドクトリンで例えるなら、歩兵サブドクトリンのどれか3つを達成すればよい。
国家方針「選挙結果が覆えされた」から始まるフィリピン王国ルートを進む。
国粋派スペインが勝った後に、国家方針「スペインとの和解」で解禁されるディシジョンから「相互援助条約」を提案し自陣営に入れる。
国家方針「フィリピン王国」でで解禁されるディシジョンから「統一を提案」しスペインを併合。
ディシジョンから共和派レジスタンスを鎮圧し中核化すると達成する。
なお史実勝者の国粋派を例に挙げたが、敵に回った無政府以外陣営（カルリスタと共和派）も提案を飲むときは飲む。
また陣営入りや統一を断られても「統合を強制」し中核化できる。
スペイン王アルフォンソ13世の息子「Juan（ファン）」と面白いの「Fun」を掛けている。
国家方針「アイゼンハワー警察署長」を完了した後に国家方針「ケソン暗殺」を完了させる。
ケソンが暗殺されるイベントでアイゼンハワーを介入させるとマッカーサーが「軍事緊急事態の宣言」を行い指導者就任、隠し国家方針が出現する。
イベントひとつひとつの感覚が大変長いのでバグと疑わないように。
現在マッカーサーが元首にならないバグが発生している。
アイコンはマッカーサーの愛用品であったコーンパイプ。
上述の「軍事緊急事態の宣言」を行うと出現する隠し国家方針には核開発を支援するバフが多く用意されている。
海外のサイトではマッカーサールートは素の国力は増えないのでこちらではなく、中核州が増えるフィリピン王国ルートを推奨している。
マッカーサーが朝鮮戦争に対し「満州側の拠点に"原子爆弾を30～50発"投下して中ソの空軍を撃滅し、満州朝鮮沿いに"放射性コバルト"を散布し汚染で進軍させないようにする」計画が元ネタ。
朝鮮戦争が第3次世界大戦に発展することを危惧したトルーマンによって却下され、マッカーサーは指揮官の座を追われることになる。

battle_royale.requirements_en: Has declared war on  China and  Japan within 90 days of another, before 01.01.1940   Has capitulated  China and  Japan
battle_royale.notes_en: Note: The requirements are a little vague & may actually be buggy - to be safe, Put at least a one day gap between your war declarations on China and Japan . That should avoid any bugs that (still) may exist. You need to declare war on China and Japan before 1940. Capitulation on the other hand has no time limit. For example, I got the achievement by end 1942. The requirement to “capitulated” means you must achieve the highest score in the war against China and the highest score in the war against Japan.  The easiest way and probably also the most consistent way (despite what others may claim) is to turn off Historical and reset until Japan goes down their Democratic / Communist path (left side of the political focus tree). This way Japan does not attack China and gives you nearly 4 years to prepare your wars with both countries. Unless you get a really bad China roll. The event in which Japans political future gets decided fires after 50 days. So resetting doesn't waste a lof of time.  During those prep years focus first on getting a bit on an economy. Go down the middle path of the focus tree until at least “Specialize CSCEC – Military Industry”. Taking “Allow Trade of Special goods” and “Promote Paper Bank Notes” is not required, but the buffs are nice. After that go down the right side of the focus tree, pick “Instill Three Rules of Discipline” and continue until “Cooperate with Ulanhu” Have one factory on artillery and the rest on guns. Later on add trains, Anti-Air and Trucks (but only when you can produce a good amount of guns and arty on a steady base).  For your army focus on Militias and put your first 100 pp in Zhu De for Army Xp. Keep mass assault as you doctrine and for sub-doctrines pick: “Guerilla Warfare”, “People’s Militia and a bit later on “Artillery & Combat Support”. Over time increase your militia template (Renmin Jundui) to 20 with and add support arty. Later on, if you can, add support Anti-Air and one artillery battalion (Which results in 22.2 combat with)  After “Cooperate with Ulanhu” finally go to the left side of the focus tree and take the “The Westward Expansion” and “The Eastward Expedition. At this point your army is already strong enough to easily win both border wars. Continue with “The Unwilling Diarchy” and “Bring War to Neighboring Warlords” Wit the factories you got form the border wars you should (if not already done) be able to increase yours militias to 20 with. Which is sufficient to destroy and annex Shanxi, The Northeastern Army, Gansu Ma and Ningxia Ma. In the mean time go down the infiltration route and after that work towards “Demand the Loyalty of the Warlords”. If you’re lucky you get Shandong.  Make sure your War Goals are ready by November 1939 by taking “Expel the Occupiers” and “Preemptive Strike” in time. 36 – 48 Militia Units with Support and one Line Arty should be sufficient to hold off and China. Together with how much you were able to infiltrate taking out China should be easy. With Historical AI off there is a good chance China joins a faction , ensuring you get the capitulation before any possible peace deal. With China’s industry added to yours protecting your coastline against Japanese naval invasions is peanuts. Just create a 12-with militia template with Artillery Support and spam enough of them.  Now only Japan is left. Start researching paratroopers and transport planes and in the meantime focus on taking out the Warlords in the north / north-east and conquer Korea after that. Now all you have to do is build an airfield in “Gyeongsang” and from there paradrop on to the Japanese mainland. You don't need an Airforce for this, Japan often doesn’t put theirs in the sky or you simply have to wait a little bit (Or simply reload the safe, it takes a few in game ours before air-superiority is registered). Your paratroopers will go (eventually). The Japanese AI doesn’t properly protect the Home Isles with soldiers either, simply have your army waiting In a / multiple ports. Once your paratroopers take one simply transport them over (don’t worry about them getting intercepted, the Navy AI seems to be death since the NCNS) and capitulate Japan. Same as China, Japan may have joined / created a faction which basically ensures you’ll see an capitulation before any possible peace deal.
battle_royale.tsv_name: Battle Royale As Communist China, fight both China and Japan before 1940 within 90 days of being at war with the other, and capitulate them both.

Note that this achievement requires ownership of your cores instead of just occupation; Although this could potentially mean a total war with the allies, the PRC actually has a focus to just request these treaty ports from their occupiers. If you use the tree to switch to Democratic and don't cause much world tension by justifying on anything, it seems that they'll give them up easily to you.

master_infiltrator.requirements_en: Is at war with with the  Reorganized National Government of the Republic of China.   Does not control any states besides Yulin (1046), Shaanbei (622), and Yan'an (1032) (when declaring)   More than 4 controlled core states have an infiltration level of 3 (after declaring)
master_infiltrator.notes_en: Very easily obtained by taking the historical Mao path with historical focuses on. Just take as many advisors that give you PP as possible. You need to make sure China does well enough to not die to Japan though - Japanese occupation prevents you from infiltrating states/will reset your infiltration progress. Don't bother infiltrating Warlord states, as both the warlord and China have decisions to remove your infiltration, meaning it gets removed much faster than just infiltrating China's states. You don't even have to actually win against Japan, if you progress far enough down the tree you'll be able to leave the United front and make your own faction, letting you declare war and get the achievement earlier. Note: This achievement is likely bugged. It is meant to check for "Is at war with any Chinese nation other than Manchukuo or the Reorganized National Government."
master_infiltrator.tsv_name: Master Infiltrator As PRC, don't expand beyond Yan'an, and infiltrate at least 5 Chinese states and flip them to your control when attacking the rest of China.

its_all_coming_together.requirements_en: You or your subjects control all starting cores of  China
its_all_coming_together.notes_en: Required states include all states needed for "Awake and Angry" - that is, starting territories of China, Chinese Soviet Republic, all warlords (including Sinkiang), Manchukuo, and Mengjiang, Kham (601) from Tibet, as well as 3 states (Taiwan, East Hebei, and Dairen) which start under Japanese control - and also the three treaty ports (Kouang-Tcheou-Wan, Macau, and Hong Kong). You don't need Korea, Mongolia, or the rest of Tibet. All states must be controlled fully (missing even one province of one state would block the achievement), so, you can have 100% faction manifest fulfillment (76/76 states controlled) without meeting the conditions. It is possible, with some luck, to get the European treaty ports handed over via the Request Handover of the Coastal Cities focus (only available in the "Dang Guo" / non-aligned focus tree branch). To increase the chances of acceptance, join their faction and their wars, and have their opinion be higher than 50.

Make sure to elect Giro Seno'o in that event. In a normal game where you join the allies in this case, the USSR might have enough warscore to steal the capitulation from you. I advise declaring war on the USSR before you cap Germany, and trying to farm as much warscore as you can before then. cobalt_sea.requirements_en: One of the following must be true:  Has launched a Nuclear Missile Strike from a Nuclear Missile Submarine with the outcomes  Success or Critical Success   Has launched a Thermonuclear Missile Strike from a Nuclear Missile Submarine with the outcomes  Success or Critical Success
cobalt_sea.notes_en: To complete this you need both a Submarine with the "Nuclear missile launcher" module (unlocked via the "Nuclear Missle Submarine" project) and at least a "Medium range nuclear missile" (unlocked via the "Nuclear Warheads" project). This requires the completion of the following special projects (somewhat in order):   Nuclear reactor (Physics, 1 breakthrough)(~720 days)  Commercial nuclear reactor (Physics, 1 breakthrough)(~720 days)  Nuclear Engines (Physics, 1 breakthrough)(~510 days)  Cruiser Submarine (Naval, 1 breakthrough)(~340 days)  Fleet submarine (Naval, 1 breakthrough)(~510 days)  Nuclear Submarine (Naval, 3 breakthrough)(~1200 days)  Ballistic Missile (Aerodynamics , 3 breakthrough)(~480 days)  Missile Launching Submarine (Naval, 2 breakthrough)(~510 days)  Nuclear Missile Submarine (Naval, 2 breakthrough)(~1440 days)  Nuclear Fission Bomb Project (Physics, 1 breakthrough)(~720 days)  Ballistic Missile (Aerodynamics , 3 breakthrough)(~480 days)  MRBM (Aerodynamics , 1 breakthrough)(~480 days)  Nuclear Warheads (Physics, 1 breakthrough)(~720 days)  Total breakthroughs needed: Physics; 5, Naval; 9, Aerodynamics; 4  Thus you will need atleast a Aerodynamics, a Naval and a Physics facility. However its recommended to have at least 2 physics facilities, so that you can work on both the engines and the bombs simultaneously. The Naval and Aerodynamics projects all build on each other, so any more than one facilities will only be used to generate more breakthroughs.  Even ignoring the duration it takes to generate breakthroughs, the earliest you will be done with this achievement, is around 1955. In 1940 you can research nuclear theory which takes till 1941. Then you can research the two reactors and the engine project, which will take you till around mid 1946. Then you can start working on the nuclear submarine. This will be done by around mid 1950. Then you will have to spend another 4 years working on the Nuclear missile submarine.  The two recommended paths for this achievements is either the secret Macarthur path, which gives research bonuses, or the "election overturned" path which gives much more core territory in which facilities can be built. If you find that your bottleneck is breakthrough, the "election overturned" path is better. On the other hand, the Macarthur path lets you start working on your nuclear research 2 years earlier and gives you speed bonuses towards nuclear special projects. Since the main load of projects that need to be completed are naval tho, this is overall not that useful.
cobalt_sea.tsv_name: Cobalt Sea As the Philippines, launch nuclear missiles from a nuclear submarine.

the_neverending_story.requirements_en: Has completed focus "Restoration of the Chinese Empire"   Fully controls all starting cores of the  Chinese Soviet Republic
the_neverending_story.notes_en: Note that even though the description doesn't say so, you actually need to fully control (but not own) all your cores as well after taking the respective focus. This adds a lot of difficulty since it means a war with the allies and potentially the soviets (if the PRC joins their faction/Sinkiang fails to unite), or try focus "Request Handover of the Coastal Cities" and border wars. Pick Guangdong Clique on historical and follow the shared tree with Guanxi Clique. Unify with Guanxi clique and don't back down with China. They will declare on you, but it's easy to just hold the line for a year and they will white peace you. Go opposition and don't join the CUF and the war against Japan, but start border wars with China and warlords to eat states off of them over time. When the final focus on the opposition tree is taken you will switch to Nat. China focus tree but you will retain the border wars mechanic. When Japan shares a border with you they will declare on you, don't join any faction and push them back together with the united front. Since you are not in faction and you have cores on all of China, whatever you conquer will be under your control and not China. When Japan is pushed back (it won't white peace because the AI doesn't accept it), declare on the CUF (At this point China should be left with 2/3 states) and capitulate it. At this point, just occupy Hong Kong, Macau and Guangzhouwan and the achievement will fire.
the_neverending_story.tsv_name: The Neverending Story As a Warlord, proclaim a new Chinese Empire.

genghis_khant.requirements_en: Owns and controls all cores of  Mongolia
genghis_khant.notes_en: It's not difficult to do this in a regular historical game by just beating Russia with the Axis after pushing out Japan. However, it can be made incredibly easy in non-historical: if Russia does any of their alt history paths but especially if they go Tsarist, then Mongolia gets spit out of their faction and is easily conquered.

doctrine_of_choice.requirements_en: Has completed any of the same subdoctrine track more than two times
doctrine_of_choice.notes_en: The description of this is somewhat obtuse, but what it actually requires is; fully complete any subdoctrine path, then swap it out to a different subdoctrine & complete it again 2 different times. (ex: Fully fill out "Defensive Postures" subdoctrine under Infantry, then swap to Assault Infantry, etc).
